A16-L31 Handheld Mortar.lore: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.

majorIds.Totemic Fuse: Totemic Smash deals +150%, +150%, +150%, and +120% but totemic smash loses 30% radius.

Abdomen.lore: "...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

Abhorrence.lore: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.

Abiogenesis.lore: Life itself is not a flexible material to work with-building sentience is precisely like squeezing blood from a stone. It may be years of toil, but the strength of an entire race that looks to you as a creator cannot be overstated.

Abolition.lore: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, Nemract Militia

Abominator.lore: Who would have thought to ever design something as pointlessly contrived and unusable as this? It's infuriating just to think about...

Abrasion.lore: "The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."

Absolution.lore: A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.

Abyss-Imbued Leggings.lore: Steeped in the deepest energies of the Ahms region void, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Abyssal Amulet.lore: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...

Abysso Galoshes.lore: Rumored to be crafted from a Dernic stone, these sinister boots radiate extremely powerful dark energy. They have absorbed the power of the raging seas in their time locked in Sarnfic.

Abyssopelagic.lore: The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.

majorIds.Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Temblor.text: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Ad Marem.lore: The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.

Adamantite.lore: Adamantite is a soft metal often added to exotic medicine to increase one's health, but a revolutionary blacksmith on Black Road, created a chestplate with an Adamantite alloy, which is advertised to bolster the users endurance.

Adder Stone.lore: Aldorei charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.

Adherence.lore: Adherence to the laws of good is important- it's why one fights the spread of corruption, after all. Though whether to follow the spirit or the letter... perhaps they too can be bent to your will.

Advancement.lore: Keep your eyes forward. The scent of the fresh earth you've kicked up proves you are moving, and the long road ahead proves you have somewhere to be.

Aersectra.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Aestival Solstice.lore: Enjoy the sun that has graced you with its longest daylight, and cherish it so that you can carry forth its warmth.

Afelis's Locket.lore: A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the Detlas square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.

Afterimage.lore: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.

Aftershock.lore: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

Ahriman.lore: Your limbs fail you, and yet you still stand. Something, someone, has invaded your body, and it will use you until your last breath.

Air Sanctuary.lore: The expanse of the skies, where the wind whistles a warbling anthem and the air extends onward forever.

Albatross.lore: And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.

Albedo.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Aleph Null.lore: It's a strange feeling, running forever to reach the horizon knowing another lies just as far past.

Alizarin.lore: This bloody palette knife was used to kill only two people before it was abandoned - a killer who broke into a great artist's home, and the artist who struck the blow.

Alka Cometflinger.lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.

majorIds.Insoluble: Dissolution now lasts 2.5 seconds, but grants only 35% resistance.

Insoluble.text: Dissolution now lasts 2.5 seconds, but grants only 35% resistance.

Alkatraz.lore: Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.

Allegiance.lore: There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."

Almuj's Daggers.lore: The reigning king of thieves in Almuj's underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.

Almuj's Walker.lore: There used to be a constant battle between Almuj's thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.

Alstroemania.lore: Look around and observe! An overcast sky; yet the blue of day seeps through the gloom, illuminating the land around you. A patch of weeds; yet flowers bloom vividly in spite of the wretched foliage surrounding them. The struggles of nature create your own personal utopia. A world, tailormade, just for you. Only you.

Alternator.lore: Llevigar's schools of wizardry are notorious for their difficult training regimens. These leg plates, forcing users to balance spellcasting with direct combat, are often cited as the tipping point for successful wizards.

Altum Spatium.lore: Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?

Ambivalence.lore: "It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you."

Anaklusmos.lore: Legends whisper of an incredible blade, that ripples the ground and shatters the tide. Formed from the waves of the sea, it's said all who wield it are untouchable. This, however... appears to just be a regular old pen?

Anarchy.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Anchoryl.lore: Despite being a much smaller settlement compared to the mighty citadel of Rodoroc, the dwarven smiths of Thanos still can forge mighty products, such as these heavy diamond-alloy boots.

Ancient Wand.lore: It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.

Andesite Aegis.lore: Andesite is a stone commonly used for weapons and construction, but tends to be ineffective as armor when impure. This sturdy chestplate, however, is testament to the strength of pure andesite.

Angel Wing Shroud.lore: Out of respect and care for the dead, bovemists cloak them in blessed shrouds to aid their spirits in passing. These efforts, however, are not respected by the dead.

Anima-Infused Cuirass.lore: Infused with the classical magicks of fire, water, and thunder, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Animosity.lore: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.

majorIds.Hurricane's Eye: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

Hurricane's Eye.text: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

Antebellum.lore: Only the naive celebrate a ceasefire. Not a second wasted, a merciless arms race against the inevitability of war has left you ready to unleash hell the moment the armistice breaks.

Anya's Penumbra.lore: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."

Apex Predator.lore: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.

Aphorism.lore: Just because it's been said to death doesn't mean it isn't true.

Apocalypse.lore: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

Apsara.lore: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.

Aquarius.lore: "The symbol of the river" is a name that is often synonymous with this garment, with many water like qualities surrounding it, heavily bathed in magical meaning.

Arakadicus' Body.lore: Long strips of chitin discarded from the mother of spiders Arakadicus still contain traces of her wicked powers, but few have survived the attempts to harvest them.

Arbiter of Iridescence.lore: Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.

Arcana.lore: The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.

Arcane Apparatus.lore: Originally intended for a more benign purpose, this piece of royal technology has been repurposed by something with far more malicious intentions. Despite the electrified water spraying from it, the smell of death never seems to wash away.

Archangel.lore: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

Archean.lore: An age of inundation. To overwhelm a vicious hell with immense waves, and protest the hand of fate. To harbor the beginning of life, and nurture a world of growth. From the fire, we are born.

Architect.lore: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.

majorIds.Living Museum: Players within 10 blocks of Mirage, Shadow, or Another Self clones will get 20% resistance, and be healed 8%, 15%, or 50% max health when the respective clone is destroyed.

Living Museum.text: Players within 10 blocks of Mirage, Shadow, or Another Self clones will get 20% resistance, and be healed 8%, 15%, or 50% max health when the respective clone is destroyed.

Aries.lore: Two iron horns adorn this helmet to enhance the warriors of the Eradian, Dwarves who specifically rode Rams into battle at incredible speed.

Arma Gauntlet.lore: Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.

Arsene.lore: I am thou... Thou art I.

majorIds.Altruism: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Altruism.text: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Ascendancy.lore: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.

majorIds.Divine Right: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 75%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 3%.

Divine Right.text: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 75%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 3%.

Ashfall Amulet.lore: The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.

Asphyxia.lore: A condition of severely deficient supply of oxygen to the body that arises from abnormal breathing; practitioners that abuse specific magic combos are often found incapacitated by said condition.

majorIds.Flurry of Blows: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

Flurry of Blows.text: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

Astral Grief.lore: The parting gift of a condemned lover: a mesh of starstuff, bound with hope. A reminder that the heavens will always guide you home. A forgiveness. This parcel never reached its destination.

Atavistic.lore: In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.

Athanasia.lore: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.

Audacity.lore: A powerful mental curse surrounds these boots, inciting uncontrollable rage into the wearers, as well as the power to enact it upon others.

Augoeides.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Aureole.lore: Double vision reshapes the moon's halo into the irises of an angel - radiant in their delicate, celestial beauty. Astigmatic lights sharpen into heavenly blades and you are the martyr to wield them.

majorIds.Heat Shimmer: Foul Play will no longer slay a Mirror Clone and will still provide its effects, but Mirror Clone count is reduced to 1. Tricks application is increased by 50%.

Autopilot.lore: Wouldn't it be nice to just let go and let something else take the wheel every now and then?

majorIds.Perfect Recall: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

Perfect Recall.text: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

Auxetic Capacitor.lore: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.

majorIds.Self-sufficient: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Self-sufficient.text: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Aviform.lore: Weightless as a fallen feather, yet lethal as a hawk’s descent. Its beveled edge reshapes the slipstream to cradle your form, tugging you through the air as you deliver strike after strike, movements blurring into a flurry of beating wings.

majorIds.Windsurf: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.

Windsurf.text: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.

Axiom.lore: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.

majorIds.Reality Revision: Phasing Beam instead makes Twain's Arc explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing its damage in a 5 block radius. Twain's Arc now has extreme recoil.

Reality Revision.text: Phasing Beam instead makes Twain's Arc explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing its damage in a 5 block radius. Twain's Arc now has extreme recoil.

Az.lore: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

Babel.lore: All legends must one day fall, but their legacy shall be remembered forevermore. These memories exist in the hearts of all, and pave the path forward in hopes to create a world where all may find peace, however rocky that path may be.

Bad Wolf.lore: The runic message carved on these enigmatic boots cover hundreds of different languages, many of them disused, but what has been translated seems to describe a disaster soon to arrive to the world.

Baleful Blizzard.lore: Whipping, chilling winds, and circling hailstones the size of boulders-the eye of your storm is the only safe place to be.

majorIds.Ice Storm: Arrow Shield and Snowstorm's radius' increase by 6 blocks. Arrow Shield's charges are doubled, but no longer give defense.

Ice Storm.text: Arrow Shield and Snowstorm's radius' increase by 6 blocks. Arrow Shield's charges are doubled, but no longer give defense.

Barrier Staff.lore: Carrying this hefty staff, you feel a sense of security and emboldenment. Its protective powers ensure you stay far out of the grasping undeads' reach.

Bartered Memory.lore: Your wit picked bare, the raw burn of reality exposing your fresh warped self to the world. Your abilities magnified, a new power ripping free from under your skin. You have traded your mind for something far, far greater.

Bated Breath.lore: The show is about to begin.

majorIds.Stagnant Air: Air Shout gains doubled area and damage, but is delayed with decreased velocity and hit rate.

Stagnant Air.text: Air Shout gains doubled area and damage, but is delayed with decreased velocity and hit rate.

Beatdown.lore: It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.

majorIds.Brutal Blow: Armour Breaker now gives an extra +10% damage and has its cooldown reduced by 5s, but lasts half as long.

Brutal Blow.text: Armour Breaker now gives an extra +10% damage and has its cooldown reduced by 5s, but lasts half as long.

Bedruthan.lore: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of Llevigar one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.

Beige Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "All STOCKINGED up for the season" knitted onto the front.

Bellicosity.lore: A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.

Binding Brace.lore: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.

Biohazard.lore: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.

majorIds.Gunk Shot: Arrow Bomb's velocity is doubled but loses -66% radius and -20% damage.

Gunk Shot.text: Arrow Bomb's velocity is doubled but loses -66% radius and -20% damage.

Bismuthinite.lore: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.

Black.lore: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.

Black Catalyst.lore: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.

Black Ripper.lore: "The skeletons at Ancient Nemract are rotted! is it even physically possible to rot a bone?" -Laen, Nemract Librarian

Black Space.lore: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.

majorIds.Find Thyself: Masquerade now grants 75 Mana after switching between Masks 3 times.

Find Thyself.text: Masquerade now grants 75 Mana after switching between Masks 3 times.

Black Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Prepare for a FLURRY of Craftmas spirit" knitted onto the front.

Blade of Purity.lore: The creator of this polished white blade insists that its true power will never be unlocked, for only those who are not influenced by the elements of the world know truly how to utilize it.

Blade of Shade.lore: The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.

Blank Stare.lore: In the marbling of wood grain. Drying moisture in the cobbles. Clumps of flowers. Tree bark, birth marks, the pattern of this plate - unflinching faces trapped, now revealed. The question pierces your mind: what shape will I be hewn into, one day?

Blazing Bangle.lore: This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.

Blazing Ruin.lore: One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.

Blessed Wrappings.lore: The thick, Bovemist-sanctified cloth is worn by their priests during certain religious ceremonies. It clears the mind and purifies the body.

Blighted Seraph.lore: Your saviour is not coming.

Blood Moon.lore: Imbued with the blood of the first werewolf, it was kept in Gelibord as a trophy before being stolen. Wearing it is said to mimic the effects of the lycanthropic curse.

Bloodbath.lore: Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.

majorIds.Coagulate: Blood Connection and Eldritch Call's teleports launch you further and higher.

Coagulate.text: Blood Connection and Eldritch Call's teleports launch you further and higher.

Blossom.lore: A mystical sapling native to the shores of Mage Island has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.

Blossom Haze.lore: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.

Blue Mask.lore: The Blue Mask's physical traits are equal to that of paper, but the mystical properties enhance the wearers personal skills tenfold. The mask is thought to originate from an ancient Dernel tribe.

Blue Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Don't feel BLUE- It's Craftmas!" knitted onto the front.

Bluetooth.lore: Forged from the fang of a ferocious beast. Despite its small size, it can land blows at considerable range.

Bob's Battle Chestplate.lore: This battered chestplate was once worn by the legendary Wynnic protector, Bob, during the fearsome corrupted sieges before he gave it away to an old friend. An air of melancholy hangs over it.

Bonder.lore: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...

Booster Plate.lore: A marvel of Corkus' electromagical advancements, this high-tech chestplate is equipped with steam jets to boost the user's speed, at a minimal cost to protection.

Boreal.lore: The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.

Boreal-Patterned Crown.lore: Engraved with the beauty and mystery of the boreal lights, this ornately-crafted crown is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Bovine Killer.lore: This helmet was worn long ago by an infamous assassin who plagued Bovemist sites for decades. It was crafted of the still-bloody skin of their most prized and worshiped cows.

Brainbleed.lore: An otherwise healthy soldier once writhed and collapsed in the confines of an outpost. His autopsy was quickly canceled when military doctors noticed an unusually rapid spread of corruption in his corpse.

Braker.lore: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.

Brambleburner.lore: Beauty and fragility go hand in hand. As nature's blossoms and branches are delightful, so are they delicate. A single spark can set the whole world into glorious blaze.

Brass Brand.lore: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.

Breakthrough.lore: An anomaly of destruction, for the conquerors who seek purpose outside of reality.

Breath of the Skies.lore: The frozen drops lashing your skin. The roar of the wind filling your ears. You've mastered it all. You can shape the winds, direct the rain. You are the storm.

Bridge of the Divide.lore: These leggings hold the interest of many researching the corruption, as they are the only documented case of a non-corrupt fusion of dark and light energy, made of pure twilight.

Bright Edge.lore: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.

Brilliant Waves.lore: The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.

Brise.lore: "With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from Nesaak, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, Elkurn Citizen

Broken Balance.lore: Torn scraps of metal line the inside of these boots. They provide no protection, instead forcing a constant adrenaline rush while worn.

Broken Sandust.lore: The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?

Bronze Basic Bracelet.lore: This bracelet is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

Bronze Basic Necklace.lore: This necklace is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

Bronze Basic Ring.lore: This ring is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

Brown Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "YULE see me smiling this season" knitted onto the front.

Brutality.lore: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.

Buoyant Balmorals.lore: These are congealed and rather gross, but they leave you with an undeniable bounce in your step.

majorIds.Combo Stomp: Landing directly on an enemy with Fierce Stomp sends you back into the air and resets Escape.

Combo Stomp.text: Landing directly on an enemy with Fierce Stomp sends you back into the air and resets Escape.

Buster Bracer.lore: A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.

Butterfly.lore: "Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, Time Valley Resident

Cacophony.lore: Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.

Cage of Bones.lore: The ancient bones of the demon Garaheth are stronger than steel. They clamp down when worn to constrict the bearer, inciting a slow madness.

Calculated Sacrifice.lore: A true tactician knows to throw even himself on the pyre, if it is for the greater good.

majorIds.Final Gambit: When Second Chance activates, all allies within 10 blocks of you get a 20% damage boost for 15s.

Final Gambit.text: When Second Chance activates, all allies within 10 blocks of you get a 20% damage boost for 15s.

Call of the Void.lore: Originating from the unspeakable dark land, looking into the helmet will show nothing but darkness. Wearing it is said to reverse your morality, as if it were draining your will to live into the void.

Call to Concord.lore: Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.

Cannonade.lore: An impenetrable fortress' greatest strength is psychological, a mythos built on the backs of a thousand attackers it has withstood. Your greatest strength is the belief that not one of those thousand could hold a candle to you.

Capricorn.lore: During a spiritual journey to Kato temple, the sage Capian was presented with powerful spiritual boots with the intention to be used for peaceful magic, and not hard combat.

Carbon.lore: A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.

Carcinization.lore: You awake in a cold sweat, finding yourself in control of two more arms and a hard exterior. You cannot make any sense of what is happening inside yourself. You cannot even explain it to yourself. How about you sleep a little bit longer and forget all this nonsense?

Carcinogen.lore: Ancient scholars claim the malevolent fungus within its plates feeds on the host's life force, granting unspeakable toxic power in return. Yet every wearer risks wasting away from the inside out.

Cardiac Arrest.lore: ...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from Aldorei Medical Tomes, Vol. 6

Carnage Agglomerate.lore: Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.

majorIds.Displace: Etheric Slash deals massive knockback to enemies hit by Teleport.

Displace.text: Etheric Slash deals massive knockback to enemies hit by Teleport.

Carole.lore: Just another song and dance.

majorIds.Incision Elegy: Lacerate becomes a forward-moving projectile, but no longer lunges.

Incision Elegy.text: Lacerate becomes a forward-moving projectile, but no longer lunges.

Cascade.lore: A great magical cataclysm at Mage Island brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.

Catabolysis.lore: Soldiers training in extreme cold conditions often push themselves beyond the limits. This however is not sustainable, as their bodies frantically scramble for survival.

majorIds.Last Resort: Bloodlust has doubled corrupted scaling and knockback, but deals -100% -60%.

Last Resort.text: Bloodlust has doubled corrupted scaling and knockback, but deals

Cataclysm.lore: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

majorIds.Rally: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Rally.text: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Cathedral.lore: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, Saint's Row Priest

Cephalothorax.lore: "...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

majorIds.Meteor Crash: Burning Sigil gains +6 radius and deals 4x the damage, but lasts half as long.

Meteor Crash.text: Burning Sigil gains +6 radius and deals 4x the damage, but lasts half as long.

Cerid's Ingenuity.lore: One of the master tinkerer Cerid's greatest inventions, these odd gear-laced boots clink and chime with the sound of clockworks keeping its powerful magic dynamos constantly running.

Cerulean Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "SLOPE to SKI you again next Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

Chained Pixels.lore: Materials of all sorts have been lashed together in this crude, blocky set of leggings. From darksteel to leather to rotting wood, each part is a perfect square. It has, so far, been impossible to recreate.

Chakram.lore: Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.

Chaleur.lore: This blackiron blade was left to sear in the desert for months on end by a fanatical berserker. It burned him alive as he cut down those who opposed him.

Champion's Valiance.lore: These leggings were forged in honour of a martyr, who, legend has it, fought off a horde of the marauders for two days without food or rest to defend his village.

Chaos Theory.lore: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.

majorIds.Uncertainty Principle: Arrow and Grape Bombs gain +1 radius and phase through enemies. Bouncing Bomb has decreased velocity and gains +1 bounces, and Grape Bombs gain increased randomness and +2 projectiles.

Uncertainty Principle.text: Arrow and Grape Bombs gain +1 radius and phase through enemies. Bouncing Bomb has decreased velocity and gains +1 bounces, and Grape Bombs gain increased randomness and +2 projectiles.

Chaos-Woven Greaves.lore: With threads of fundamentally opposing magic delicately woven together, these ornately-crafted greaves are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Charlatan.lore: Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.

Charred Bone.lore: The carving on this antiquated spear writes: Locedtuh Hahod

Chaser.lore: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?" -Dr. Junes, Almuj Archaeologist

Chimaera.lore: The one true Chimera in existence is sought by many, for great stories are told of its gifts to the worthy. One such gift was a simple fur coat, which gave the wearer but a taste of its power.

Chipped Glitz.lore: There are little chips and cracks all over this... was someone trying to break it down for gold?

Cinfras Souvenir T-Shirt.lore: The shirt has the quote "I went to the Letvus Airbase in Cinfras and all I got was this lousy T-shirt" printed on it.

Clairvoyance.lore: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.

Clash Hook.lore: The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.

Claustropelia.lore: The swirl of liquid muck drags you further, further down, into the grasping clutches of the gluttonous hands of the sludge. The earth must be fed; preferably, by something less powerful than you.

Clearsight Spectacles.lore: Ancient magicks are required to make these brilliant glasses, imbued with charity and selflessness. They allow sight beyond sight, rumoured to allow sight of a brilliant realm.

requirements.quest: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Realm of Light III - A Headless History

Cloudburst.lore: Nothing stands out about these thin greaves at a glance. But sometimes, when the time is right, a tempestuous power rushes through them: your legs moving as by themselves, and taking leaps that they should never be able to.

Clunderthap.lore: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance." -Lanu, Almuj Archaeomancer

Cluster.lore: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...

Cnidarian Hellspawn.lore: A million stinging needles, tangled around your head; A crown of thorns; A wreath of nematocysts; A chaplet of venom and pain. From that poison cup, you drink and drink, until-Like a jellyfish-Only the currents decide your way. Until only an addictive Hate compels you.

Coeur Brise.lore: Left to brittle introspection, love unrequited stings the most when it brings down something built to last.

Cold Wave.lore: Feeling the fresh chill of the cold air is all you need to know you're really alive.

Collapse.lore: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.

majorIds.Fission: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Fission.text: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Collection.lore: An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.

Compliance.lore: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."

Concentration.lore: The forger of this ring had to endure 30 long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.

Conductor.lore: Using an unorthodox method of smithing, these copper leggings are insulated with an extremely conductive blend of liquid to improve electrical discharge.

Confiscated.lore: She's taken all you have. Your blood. Your sweat. Your tears. You must repay the debt, no matter the consequences, so that what was stolen will be returned tenfold.

Conflagrate.lore: Donning this helmet sears your mind with images of a world on fire. These blistering thoughts pressure you to make that world a reality.

Consolidate.lore: An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion. Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.

Conspirator's Trickpockets.lore: No reign lasts forever. Not while your schemes remain unnoticed.

Continuum.lore: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.

Contrast.lore: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.

Convergence.lore: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.

Corpse.lore: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired Ragni Soldier

Cracked Stonehall.lore: It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...

Crackshot.lore: This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.

Cremation.lore: The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.

Crown of Jewels.lore: A symbol of authority, power, and the right to rule. Let Her leadership burn brightly forevermore, leading us into a new era of strength.

Crown of Vicious Leaves.lore: The leaves in this coronet cackle and hiss, a cacophony of malicious intent. They would just as soon shred your enemies to bits as remove your own head from your shoulders.

majorIds.Ignition Whirlwind: Blazing Powder adds +8 rotations to spin attack, but lowers the damage by 75%.

Ignition Whirlwind.text: Blazing Powder adds +8 rotations to spin attack, but lowers the damage by 75%.

Cruel Sun.lore: The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.

Crumbler.lore: There is no need to swing this weapon. Your skin crackles as the mere presence of the blade rends the earth beneath it, to falling skies and gaping chasms. Once the dust settles and the air stills, the sword is the only telltale remnant of the catastrophe.

Crumbling Foundation.lore: It always returns a little weaker than what it was before. Perhaps someday, it'll be put down for good.

majorIds.Entropy: Meteor's speed is increased by 50%.

Crusade Sabatons.lore: One of the very few physically-powerful artifacts of the Villagers, these boots were used in the initial crusades against the Green-skins, to overpower the Orcs via raw physical might. Though effective, they have not seen use in a long time.

Cryoseism.lore: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.

Crystal.lore: Forged on Mage Island, the sparkling liquid-like armour is as hard as obsidian, but light and fluid as water. It glistens with the magic of the ocean winds.

Cyclo.lore: A centuries-old storm spirit was banished to these tight boots for his destructive actions. His fury empowers those who wear them with the great force of a raging cyclone.

Cypress Amber.lore: "Discernable by its one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape." -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, 2nd Edition.

Dance Among the Stars.lore: Carelessly aloft, between the heavens and the abyss...

Dark Matter.lore: It permeates around you, so subtly, enveloping your very being with a shroud on the cusp of impalpability. Nothing can affect you now - the incorporeal hiding in plain sight.

Dark Shroud.lore: Wearing this deceptively simple shroud causes the user to fade into the shadows, sometimes flickering out of existence for a moment.

Darkiron Scrap.lore: Despite being only an impure scrap of the normally sturdy blackiron, these heavy leggings still have extreme defensive capabilities.

Dawnbreak.lore: Many prophecies foretell of new eras. Most are fabricated or proven false in time. One passed through the Dogun caverns, however, tells of a dawn soon to break, in which the earth shall run red and return to flame. Fanatical sects whisper the coming of a new demonic god.

Dead Samurai's Plate.lore: "We get a lot of weirdos coming from Gavel by airship. That plate mail looked unusably ornate!" -Calo, Private Airship Operator

Dead Sands.lore: Found in the middle of the Almuj desert, these greaves slowly engulf everything around it in flames. The heat of the desert sun has seared it heavily, empowering it with the fury of the Sun.

Deadeye.lore: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, Rymek Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.

Death Grasp.lore: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.

Death's Reach.lore: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion

Decaybound Spindle.lore: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.

Deep Breaths.lore: Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.

Detachment.lore: An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.

Detlas' Legacy.lore: One of Detlas' buildings was struck by lightning 60 years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.

Devil's Oath.lore: Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"

Diablo.lore: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.

Diamond Fiber Bracelet.lore: Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.

Diamond Fiber Necklace.lore: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.

Diamond Fiber Ring.lore: This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.

Diamond Fusion Bracelet.lore: This bracelet opens up its wearers spirit, filling it with pure elemental knowledge. The ornaments decorating it are without peer.

Diamond Fusion Necklace.lore: Unlike any other invention this necklace enhances your power and understanding of the elements tenfold. The colorful jewels used are almost dizzying you.

Diamond Fusion Ring.lore: This mighty ring is the crown jewel amongst elemental rings. Wearing it, your knowledge is no longer limited to a few elements.

Diamond Hydro Bracelet.lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this bracelet on your arm you could ride a wave with your bare feet.

Diamond Hydro Necklace.lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said and every word was true. With this necklace equipped, you could hear the ocean whisper.

Diamond Hydro Ring.lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this ring on your finger, you could catch a gnat without looking.

Diamond Solar Bracelet.lore: The device forged into this perfected bracelet drains all heat from its surroundings. Though it almost burns, you can feel your power growing

Diamond Solar Necklace.lore: The masterpiece of a necklace gathers all heat from its surrounding. It is fed to its wearer to maximize the strength of attacks.

Diamond Solar Ring.lore: The device forged into this flawless ring draws all heat from its surrounding. Though it almost burns, you can feel your abilites enhance.

Diamond Static Bracelet.lore: The heavy shocks coming from this perfected bracelet would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is the enhancement of power.

Diamond Static Necklace.lore: The lethal amount of electricity emmited from this often desired necklace fails to kill you, as its pure energy runs through your veins.

Diamond Static Ring.lore: The heavy electrical impulses coming from this ring would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is pure power. A true masterpiece of engineering.

Diamond Steam Bracelet.lore: This steam-powered bracelet is sought by many challengers of the Legendary Challenge. They say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.

Diamond Steam Necklace.lore: This necklace is the pinnacle of steam-powered technology. Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from the necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all.

Diamond Steam Ring.lore: Users of this perfect model of Legendary Island's steam-powered ring have reported feeling weightless in combat. The jewel of the ring is a perfectly clear diamond.

Dilation.lore: Watch the clock freeze. The silence before the storm drags like an eternity, so reinforce your gear, steady your restless mind, and brace yourself for the long haul.

Diluted Vitriol.lore: The glass capsule holding the poison vial is too cloudy to see what's inside. The merchant's reassurances are anything but.

Diminution.lore: Don't blink. The brightest moments in life slip away in an instant, so etch every memory in your brain, and reach for them when you face your darkest hour.

Disco.lore: Recovered from a corrupted soldier who wore them, it was found dancing instead of attacking those around it. Even after it was killed, it jostled and jerked around like a dancing puppet.

Discoverer.lore: Wealth and riches...but at what cost?

Disfigured Vessel.lore: An imperfect fit, but you can make a better one.

Dislocater.lore: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.

Dispersion.lore: "The lucky ones perished in the abyss. It's only a matter of time before the land picks us survivors off one by one."

majorIds.Scarce Comfort: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

Scarce Comfort.text: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

Divergence.lore: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.

Divzer.lore: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

Dogfight.lore: The Nesaak wolves have been driven to aggression by corruption. Witnesses have seen entire packs decimate each other in fierce and brutal skirmishes. This necklace is adorned with teeth recovered from those incidents, and wearing it gives you the feeling of a wolf about to bite at your neck.

Dondasch.lore: The sheer bond between Adamastor and Urdar has manifested itself into a physical form due to their duress. Such power is not to be abused...

Doomsday Omen.lore: Something is lurking-it must be, in the eerie silence that leaves you so utterly alone. And these remains... Are they a reminder of one who didn't stay quiet, or does what lurks in the unknown already know you're here?

Lightweight.text: You no longer take fall damage.

Downfall.lore: A fallen link from a chainmail hauberk of an older time, this ring fell from a giant taller than a mountain. As it sped through the air and gained momentum, it traveled so fast that it was battered to a tenth of its size.

Dreamer's Soul.lore: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.

majorIds.Oneiro: Your maximum Mana Bank is increased by 50, but your spells now charge it by -3 less per hit.

Oneiro.text: Your maximum Mana Bank is increased by 50, but your spells now charge it by -3 less per hit.

Dreamstealer.lore: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.

Drenched Igneous.lore: Found at the bottom of a hydrothermal trench, this incredibly dense stone has been warped and shifted into the shape of armor, containing the strength of the Earth, its water, and all of its awe-inspiring heat.

Dulled Amethyst Ring.lore: The merchant insists the gem is real. It's easy to tell that the issue is the quality of the gem, though...

Dune Beast Jaw.lore: "We're trying to dig up history, not horrors! What is wrong with this province?!" -Excavator Vade, WynnExcavation Site A Director

Dune Kiln.lore: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, Almuj Glassblower

Durum's Serenity.lore: Carried by the Durum Protector, this small necklace holds but an ounce of the vibrance and life of the Durum Isles.

Earth Sanctuary.lore: The heart of the earth, where the ground blooms beautiful blossoms and life grows untethered.

Echoes of the Lost.lore: Distant wails of a bygone time still chime amidst impossibly tall walls of stone – now nothing more than memories, mere mimics of lonely cries.

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Sorcery.text: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Eden-Blessed Guards.lore: Consecrated by Qira herself with blessings unknown to all but her, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Effervescence.lore: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.

Ego.lore: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.

majorIds.Oneself Unto All: Radiance's radius extends 4 blocks beyond Bash and buffs allies with your stats instead of theirs.

Oneself Unto All.text: Radiance's radius extends 4 blocks beyond Bash and buffs allies with your stats instead of theirs.

Ehrfurcht.lore: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.

Eleventh Hour.lore: The last stand, a hero's rally, a turning tide-is it a tale of a champion who conquered, or a martyr who inspired? This is your story to tell.

majorIds.Saviour's Sacrifice: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

Saviour's Sacrifice.text: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

Ellipsism.lore: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.

Elysium-Engraved Aegis.lore: Dedicated to a place of courage revered by all warriors, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Embrittlement.lore: Shards of frost and bone, fragments of memories and worlds; it all shatters under your step. The cracks reach deep. Too deep. Your soul rests on thin ice.

Empathy Purge.lore: Tiny spikes lining the inside of these boots suppress the grey matter in the wearer's brain, enhancing their capabilities and making them capable of murderous and immoral acts while in this trance-like, numbed state.

Empire Builder.lore: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of Almuj. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'

majorIds.Divine Honor: Increases the bonus from Radiance by 5%. Bash deals -15% per hit.

Divine Honor.text: Increases the bonus from Radiance by 5%. Bash deals

Enhanced Assassin's Hood.lore: The chains comprising the mesh are rusty and old. It looks terrible, especially with the newer metal added on.

Enhanced Coalwalkers.lore: Even ignoring the numerous scorches all over, these boots hardly look any better.

Enhanced Copper Plate.lore: The merchant insists that the wear and oxidation on the armor "is a feature."

Enhanced Duskshield.lore: They look extremely bulky and uncomfortable...do they have a right to call it "enhanced"?

Enhanced Gypsum.lore: The merchant launched into a tirade on how the hardness scale of stones means nothing the instant you saw part of the boots flake off upon being touched.

Enhanced Hilltop.lore: Looks like it was hastily repainted to match the colors of the mesa. ...but you can see the original greens and browns underneath.

Enhanced Icarus.lore: Apparently, gluing some feathers on top of the decorative armor wings is supposed to allow you to fly- so says the merchant, at least.

Enhanced Meditation Robe.lore: The psalm tag has been replaced with a custom message from the armorer. What it says about the original owner is better left to the imagination.

Enhanced Oxford.lore: They look like at once point they may have been fairly upscale. Now they just look like a metallic mess.

Enhanced Panorama.lore: They added stilts to the leggings, so that they could "live up to the name." The fact you can barely stand in them is neatly avoided when you ask.

Enhanced Phosphene.lore: The paintjob on the armor is incredibly garish. Who thinks to combine sea green, mud, hot pink, and neon yellow?

Enhanced Pickpockets.lore: Aside from the added plating, they look more or less intact. Somehow, that doesn't surprise you.

Enhanced Salience.lore: Adding hard metal onto a religious cap seems blasphemous to you. The merchant disagrees.

Enhanced Skeleton Boots.lore: Some of the bones used to make the frame of the boots have crumbled. The merchant refuses to comment.

Enhanced Umbrella Hat.lore: The only difference you can see is that a tacky logo for Rymek Armoury has been stenciled onto the top.

Enhanced Zeal.lore: Supposedly this chestplate belonged to a legendary paladin. The merchant has no explanation for why there are dozens of them.

Ensa's Faith.lore: The scholar-priest Ensa created this pendant as a personal prayer while his home was under siege. It is rumored to hold the key to enlightenment, but it is unknown as to how.

Enshrouded Eruption.lore: Recovered from subterranean ash deposits, these timeworn greaves are one of many relics of war buried in combat by an ancient eruption. Entombed by millennia of rock and soil, the ideologies of the belligerents have been long forgotten: all that remains is their endless desire for absolution.

Ephemeris.lore: A pair of glowing sabatons crafted from time-lost relics. Somehow, despite just creating them, you get the feeling that you've worn these before...

majorIds.Self-sufficient: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Self-sufficient.text: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Epoch.lore: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.

Equinox Blossom.lore: Perennial, in a sense-these plants cycle through a unique bloom for every season. When they fully form, the breathtaking equinox is said to shine with an otherworldly light.

Eradian Cuissards.lore: Abandoned by the dwarven Ramriders in their heyday, this hefty armor forged to protect a steed sees little use but littering the steppes of the upper heights. A memento of a slaughter, in days long past.

Erratio.lore: The blind prophet who crafted this macabre breastplate used the bones of only the most ruthless justiciars and executioners. Its wearers are supposedly destined to only die either a heroic or a just death.

Eruption.lore: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.

Eschaton.lore: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.

majorIds.Death Sentence: Courage will immediately combust Guardian Angels, dealing 4000% and enkindling Buckshot's arrows with 20% Main Attack damage.

Death Sentence.text: Courage will immediately combust Guardian Angels, dealing

Esclavage.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Esteemed Bronze Mask of Legendary Victor.internalName: Esteemed Bronze Mask of Legendary Victory
Esteemed Bronze Mask of Legendary Victor.lore: This decorative mask, crafted of bronze alloys, is awarded only to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Eternal Toil.lore: Shift after shift, the workers gave everything they had. Quota after quota, even that was not enough. They could only take so much of this before their very spirit was forever broken.

Ethereal.lore: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.

Etiolation.lore: Despite the absence of natural light, in the deepest reaches of the Void grows foliage and flora capable of sustaining itself by absorbing latent energy. Such an accomplishment is to be admired, ideally from a keen distance.

Event Horizon.lore: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.

Excision of Trust.lore: They'll never believe you again.

Extinction.lore: The Decay swept away countless species. As those memories die, they are lost forever.

Eyes on All.lore: A presence of despair watches over the swamp as the Decay spreads.

Faction.lore: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.

False Idol.lore: Without your god, whom else is there to turn to but me?

majorIds.Sun Eater: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

Sun Eater.text: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

Fangs.lore: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident

Fantasia.lore: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.

Fatal.lore: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

majorIds.Unstable Reaction: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

Unstable Reaction.text: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

Fate.lore: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.

majorIds.Starcrossed: Hitting an enemy with Haunting Memory makes it Linked. You can have up to two targets Linked at once. When one Linked enemy takes damage, the other Linked enemy takes that damage as well. Haunted Memory's duration is increased by 5 seconds and its range is increased by 10 blocks.

Starcrossed.text: Hitting an enemy with Haunting Memory makes it Linked. You can have up to two targets Linked at once. When one Linked enemy takes damage, the other Linked enemy takes that damage as well. Haunted Memory's duration is increased by 5 seconds and its range is increased by 10 blocks.

Faustian Contract.lore: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.

Fenmask.lore: This matted tangle of vines and marshland plants contains various herbal remedies woven into it. It is oddly comfortable, despite the thorns coating the inside.

Fidelius.lore: You have seen the worst the world has to offer, and met it with a cold, determined gaze. You kill for those who cannot defend themselves. The battle is everlasting, but you are a durable soldier. Push through; for honour, for glory, for truth.

Field.lore: "After the Nivla forest fire, I'm glad the corrupteds haven't thought to try and burn the Detlas Suburbs." -Sergeant Klafson, Detlas Legion

Fierce Thunder.lore: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.

Fierte.lore: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the Molten Heights.

Final Spark.lore: You have gotten tired of the abyss staring back. Embrace it in a finale that leaves no survivors.

majorIds.Desperate Measures: Walk Speed increases by 1% and Jump Height increases by 2% for every 1% hp missing.

Desperate Measures.text: Walk Speed increases by 1% and Jump Height increases by 2% for every 1% hp missing.

Fire Sanctuary.lore: The house of the flames, where the sky runs red with rage and passion burns through every soul.

Firebird.lore: From the ashes, let a hero rise anew.

majorIds.Phoenix-Born: Health Regeneration is increased by 0.75% for every 1% Health missing.

Phoenix-Born.text: Health Regeneration is increased by 0.75% for every 1% Health missing.

Firebomb.lore: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?

majorIds.Napalm: Fire Creep increases Arrow Bomb damage by +15%, but deals 15 times the self-damage and lowers velocity. Scorched Earth radius is increased and deals +65%.
