Firemoss Lyre.lore: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.

Firewall.lore: Some places must be protected at all costs. In a frigid, worldwide desert of apathy and ruination, there somehow still remain some oases of love and warmth. Keep them safe, as long as you can.

Fissure.lore: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

majorIds.Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Temblor.text: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Flagellant.lore: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.

Flameshot Hilt.lore: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.

Folds of Infinity.lore: Lose yourself in the climb.

majorIds.Slow Boil: Bakal's Grasp and Enraged Blow have their caps doubled, but Corruption charges 20% as fast.

Slow Boil.text: Bakal's Grasp and Enraged Blow have their caps doubled, but Corruption charges 20% as fast.

Follow the Wind.lore: A lost relic from the Wind Fortress, a mythical stronghold of the Sky Islands that fell into the Void long ago. A small mechanism within the bracelet points towards its place of origin.

Fool's Errand.lore: Is it bravery or stupidity that compels you to stare into the jaws of death once more?

majorIds.Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.

Forbearance.lore: An anomaly of restriction, for the protectors who seek purpose outside of reality.

Forlorn Pursuit.lore: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so much refuse from the world above.

majorIds.Scarce Comfort: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

Scarce Comfort.text: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

Found Footage.lore: Despite heavy damage, this memory core recovered from a fallen Despermech remains usable. Sifting through its contents paints a clear yet brutal picture of the destruction the rogue creations have caused.

Fractal.lore: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?

Fragile Truce.lore: The enemy of your enemy is your friend. It's naught but a ceasefire of convenience, if not necessity, yet it's a chance to lick your wounds and focus your might against the threat at hand.

Freedom.lore: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.

Frenetic Firestorm.lore: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.

Frondescere.lore: Perched atop treetops far above, you watch the gentle sway of branches, leaves caressing the playful wind, and you finally feel at home.

majorIds.Brachiate: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

Brachiate.text: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

Frozen Devotion.lore: Crystalline towers and stark white horizons. The sharpest frost shards and the softest snowfall. Before the permafrost monarch of winter, lay your heart down: become the right hand of the cold.

majorIds.Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -10%.

Juggle.text: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by

majorIds.Self-sufficient: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Self-sufficient.text: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Gadgeteer.lore: This suit was clearly designed by the hand of a mechanic, though its purpose is unknown. There are quite a lot of buttons on it though, so let's press this one!

Gaea-Hewn Boots.lore: Forged in direct tribute to the earth and its aspects, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Gaia.lore: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.

majorIds.Earthen Splinter: Quake channels nature energy into a powerful root, travelling underground and emerging under the nearest mob for 1200%.

Earthen Splinter.text: Quake channels nature energy into a powerful root, travelling underground and emerging under the nearest mob for

Gale's Force.lore: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.

Gale's Sight.lore: True to their promise, these goggles were left as a memento for Ohms when his lover Gale finally died. Light as air, Gale's carefree nature lends itself to those who don them.

Galleon.lore: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.

Gambler's Ruin.lore: Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.

Garoth's Hope.lore: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher

Gemini.lore: The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.

Gert Super Special Magic Ultistick.lore: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.

Ghostly Quasar.lore: An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.

Giant Step.lore: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.

Giant's Bracer.lore: This ill-fitting, bulky chestplate was never intended to be a chestplate at all. Rather, it is a broken fragment of an arm bracer, from the time of giants.

Glacial Crest.lore: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.

Glare.lore: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.

Glass Skin.lore: Peeled off of a desiccated corpse, what remains of the skin is brittle. A precise enough strike can crack the wrapping and embed sharp fragments straight into the wearer's wrist.

Gleam.lore: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?

majorIds.Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Geocentrism.text: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Gold Digger.lore: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner

Gold Fiber Bracelet.lore: This rough looking bracelet utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You can feel a rhythm with each step...

Gold Fiber Necklace.lore: This improved version of a bracelet utilizes rare electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You notice a rhythm with each step...

Gold Fiber Ring.lore: This improved ring utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You can sense a rhythm with each step...

Gold Fusion Bracelet.lore: This bracelet, decorated with complex ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. Though powerful, there's still a lot to improve.

Gold Fusion Necklace.lore: This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses advanced nano-technology to boost its users elemental abilities. Though powerful, there are still a few flaws to be fixed.

Gold Fusion Ring.lore: This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a powerful elemental force in you. Though stronger than the previous model, its true potential stays sealed.

Gold Hydro Bracelet.lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

Gold Hydro Necklace.lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

Gold Hydro Ring.lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant insisted. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

Gold Solar Bracelet.lore: The device forged into this improved bracelet seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your arm...

Gold Solar Necklace.lore: The device forged into this advanced necklace seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your neck...

Gold Solar Ring.lore: The device forged into this advanced ring seems to absorb heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your hand...

Gold Static Bracelet.lore: The painful shock coming from this improved version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

Gold Static Necklace.lore: The strong shock coming from this improved version of the necklace is a small price for its strength, but it has yet to reach its peak.

Gold Static Ring.lore: The strong shock coming from this advanced version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

Gold Steam Bracelet.lore: This impressive bracelet is in high demand. Those who have obtained it say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.

Gold Steam Necklace.lore: The jewel hanging from this necklace is said to be weightless. While still very powerful, its full potential has yet to be achieved.

Gold Steam Ring.lore: While this model of the Steam Ring is far superior to its predecessor, there still lies the capacity for one more upgrade. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.

Golden Staff.lore: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.

Golem's Arm.lore: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?

Goredrinker.lore: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.

Gospel.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Grand Design.lore: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.

majorIds.Ergosphere: Storm Dance instead lets your Totems pull enemies within their radius. Totem duration is decreased.

Ergosphere.text: Storm Dance instead lets your Totems pull enemies within their radius. Totem duration is decreased.

Grandmother.lore: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.

Granitic Mettle.lore: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.

majorIds.Rock Shield: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

Rock Shield.text: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

Gravity.lore: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.

majorIds.Magnet: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

Magnet.text: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

Greatbird Eyrie.lore: Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.

Greaves of Purest Obsidian.lore: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.

Greaves of the Veneer.lore: Forged from mystic, previously unknown metals revealed in the deepest dwarven mining site to date, these sleek, glowing greaves are believed to be utterly indestructible.

Green Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "I'm feeling PINE, what about you" knitted onto the front.

Grillface.lore: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of Rodoroc's elite.

Grimtrap.lore: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

majorIds.Torment Liturgy: Shadow Siphon now immediately refreshes Vanish when triggered, but reduces Surprise Strike's multiplier by -30%.

Torment Liturgy.text: Shadow Siphon now immediately refreshes Vanish when triggered, but reduces Surprise Strike's multiplier by -30%.

Grisly Gauntlet.lore: A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.

Guard's Garment.lore: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside Ragni. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet...

Guardian.lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

majorIds.Guardian: Devout Union gains +20% damage redirection and +4 radius.

Guardian.text: Devout Union gains +20% damage redirection and +4 radius.

H-209 Miniature Defibrillator.lore: Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.

H-215 Plasmatic Exograft.lore: A paper cut triggers immediate cauterization. A cracked rib is instantly encased in a cage of white-hot plasma. You did not ask to wake up smoking every morning, but according to diagnostic logs, your survival rate has never been higher.

majorIds.Sublimation: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

Sublimation.text: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

Hadal.lore: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

Hadean.lore: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.

Halcyon.lore: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.

majorIds.Blinding Lights: All Ophanim orbs deal 250% damage, gain +5 Crystallize per hit, and instead orbit around you. Using Main Attack causes all orbs to travel faster.

Blinding Lights.text: All Ophanim orbs deal 250% damage, gain +5 Crystallize per hit, and instead orbit around you. Using Main Attack causes all orbs to travel faster.

Hanafubuki.lore: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

majorIds.Efflorescence: Serpent's Garden now centers to where you land with Swan Dive. Damage of Swan Dive, Serpent's Garden and Jasmine Bloom are distributed across all elements.

Haros' Oar.lore: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.

Harsh Noise.lore: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.

Harwrol.lore: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.

Hashr Claw.lore: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside." -Attributed to Hashr

Heart of Shadow.lore: Two sides of the same coin.

majorIds.Bound by Blood: Shadow Projection's teleport range, duration, and launch strength is doubled.

Bound by Blood.text: Shadow Projection's teleport range, duration, and launch strength is doubled.

Forest's Blessing.text: Your hound gains 50% more movement speed, attack speed and vision. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by

Hearthkeeper.lore: Childhood memories, days of late nights and snow fights and cocoa by the fireside. Loving smiles and friendly faces. The beating heart of the world: home. This is what you fight for, beating back those dark and wicked forces which work to break down all that is loved. There is no sacrifice too great for the hearth.

majorIds.Altruism: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Altruism.text: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Heat Death.lore: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?

Heaven's Gate.lore: Among the outcasts of Efilim, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.

Hecatomb.lore: For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.

Heliophilia.lore: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.

majorIds.Gentle Glow: Orphion's Pulse restores 10% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

Gentle Glow.text: Orphion's Pulse restores 10% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

Hellbound.lore: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

majorIds.Dauntless Inferno: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing 150% each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.

Dauntless Inferno.text: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing
each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.

Hellstrand.lore: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.

Helm Splitter.lore: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.

Hephaestus-Forged Sabatons.lore: Honoring a mythical dwarven smith lost to the legends, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Heracul.lore: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.

Herald of Ruin.lore: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.

majorIds.Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

Heretic.lore: What once crowned the Commander of Aelumia's Gendarmerie, now reduced to a singed fragment of its former self.

majorIds.Burnt Shadows: Buried Light burns faster and is controlled by the direction you face. Enemies in the light instead take 120%.

Burnt Shadows.text: Buried Light burns faster and is controlled by the direction you face. Enemies in the light instead take

Hero.lore: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.

majorIds.Saviour's Sacrifice: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

Saviour's Sacrifice.text: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

Hero's Mask.lore: It bears the visage of a great hero. Thank you for participating in the Festival of the Heroes!

Hesperium.lore: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

majorIds.Fission: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Fission.text: Explosions from your Exploding ID are twice as big and twice as strong.

Hetusol.lore: The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.

Hex-Master Anchor.lore: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.

Hexed Amulet.lore: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, Olux-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.

Holy Greaves.lore: Many blacksmiths have tried to craft their products in this armor's image, but none so far have been able to capture the brilliance of these Bovemist-blessed greaves.

Homeorhesis.lore: Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.

Horamancer.lore: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.

Hourglass.lore: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant

Hourslip.lore: Let time slip away. The nature of the mind is to wander, so stare blankly at the sky, let go of your worries, and enjoy a carefree day.

Hubris.lore: You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.

majorIds.Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Geocentrism.text: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Hunger.lore: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.

Hurricane Recurve.lore: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

Hydrogen.lore: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

Hydrotoxemia.lore: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.

Hymn of the Dead.lore: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest

Hypoxia.lore: You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.

Hypsophobia.lore: Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-

Idealogue.lore: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

Idol.lore: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

majorIds.Tidal Drift: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

Tidal Drift.text: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

Ignis.lore: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

majorIds.Dragon's Breath: Buckshot will heal allies for 100% of your total Health Regen.

Dragon's Breath.text: Buckshot will heal allies for 100% of your total Health Regen.

Ignition.lore: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the Canyon of the Lost hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.

Iklaj.lore: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher

Immolation.lore: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

Impact Winter.lore: Do you think you can survive with a sky choked by snow and ash? More importantly, do you think anything else can?

Impatience.lore: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.

majorIds.Split Second: Aura now travels faster with Invigorating Wave unlocked, but no longer gives mana.

Split Second.text: Aura now travels faster with Invigorating Wave unlocked, but no longer gives mana.

Impossibility Threshold.lore: Visions unknowable and faces unnamed. A violent cacophony with no end in sight. But beyond that- a clarity. A fleeting moment where the rules speak their names, just on the other side. You need to get closer. You need to be able to see.

Impulse.lore: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.

Inclemency.lore: Only the strongest are able to survive Nesaak's unforgivingly harsh conditions. From the frigid temperatures to the vicious wildlife and grotesque corrupteds, life here can feel like challenge after challenge.

Incognito.lore: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.

majorIds.Disassociate: You can now have twice the Nightcloak Knives, but they each deal 30% less damage.

Disassociate.text: You can now have twice the Nightcloak Knives, but they each deal 30% less damage.

Incoherence.lore: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.

Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Leg.internalName: Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Legendary Victory
Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Leg.lore: This cheap paper mask drawn in the likeness of Herbert von Legendary as he was having a complete nervous breakdown after having his life threatened by people who would not stop challenging him, is handed over in the ill-conceived hope of easing the murderous tendencies of those who have spent unnecessary amounts of time, broken the mold, gone even further beyond, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop, ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession, and then came to blows in Doctor Legendary's house demanding further prizes all for the singularly unsettling and quite possibly sociopathic purpose of spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge. The inside has the names and addresses of multiple notable psychoanalysts written with a hastily-scrawled note from Doctor Legendary himself begging that you stop completing the Legendary Challenge and go get therapy before you do something to him that would constitute legal action against you.

Incorporeal.lore: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.

Indigo Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "GRAUPELING with a second helping of Craftmas feast" knitted onto the front.

Inebriation.lore: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.

Infernal Impulse.lore: If the depths of hell allows you this, is staying human an equal trade or a fool's choice?

majorIds.Rally: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Rally.text: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Inferno.lore: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

Infernus Aeterna.lore: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.

majorIds.Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Geocentrism.text: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Infinitesimal.lore: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

Infinity.lore: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

majorIds.Evershot: Arrow Hurricane becomes a consistent, straight stream of arrows with a slower fire rate, dealing greater knockback and triple damage per arrow. Additionally, Arsenal Synergy requires 10 less arrows for each flint arrow.

Evershot.text: Arrow Hurricane becomes a consistent, straight stream of arrows with a slower fire rate, dealing greater knockback and triple damage per arrow. Additionally, Arsenal Synergy requires 10 less arrows for each flint arrow.

Influence.lore: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.

Infused Hive Bow.lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.

Infused Hive Dagger.lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.

Infused Hive Relik.lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.

Infused Hive Spear.lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.

Infused Hive Wand.lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.

Ingress.lore: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.

Inhibitor.lore: There's a note in it. It doesn't seem to be addressed to you... "You're not beyond saving. But you must work to deserve to be saved."

Inhumanity.lore: Exploitation is a game as old as time, but rarely one to be played so transparently. When war reaches your doorstep, though, the facade of civility falls-there is no shame in bleeding an enemy dry.

majorIds.Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Seeking Module.text: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Inordinate.lore: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.

Inquisitor's Zeal.lore: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

Insignia.lore: To wear the mark is more than a show of allegiance. It is a willingness to channel the might of the gods at whatever cost, as the fate of the battle is worth more than surviving to see its end.

majorIds.Superconductor: Chain Lightning channels three massive lightning bolts through you, arcing to enemies within 8 blocks for 270% and stunning them for 1s. You take 10% more damage for 4s.

Superconductor.text: Chain Lightning channels three massive lightning bolts through you, arcing to enemies within 8 blocks for
and stunning them for 1s. You take 10% more damage for 4s.

Intensity.lore: The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.

Invariant.lore: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.

Iosis.lore: The last step towards purity. Dissolve and coagulate. Be anew.

majorIds.Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Temblor.text: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Iron Knuckle.lore: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

Iron Medallion.lore: A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...

Iron String.lore: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.

Isostatic Rebound.lore: Death is naught but an inconvenience for the strongest of the corrupted. With time, the weight of destruction will pass, and the fires of War will rise anew from within.

Iterative Loop.lore: Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.

Ivory.lore: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.

Ivy Whip.lore: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

Jamais Vu.lore: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.

Jaw Breaker.lore: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10 emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

Jiandan Handwraps.lore: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.

Jungle Rogue.lore: King of the Jungle-it's a title reserved for the apex of the apex, and yet from where you swing across the canopy, this beast of supposed royalty is but another victim of your thievish pursuits.

majorIds.Brachiate: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

Brachiate.text: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

Jurisdiction.lore: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.

Kalorite Jewel.lore: A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself, and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.

Karma.lore: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing." -Ormrod, Self-exiled Almuj Resident

Katoa's Warmth.lore: Brilliantly golden as the crops from the humble farm, its mere presence fills stomachs and brings comfort, but only to those who are modest and generous.

Kaze.lore: Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.

Keen Eye.lore: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.

majorIds.Soul Eater: Devour and Harvester grant double mana. Decreases maximum marks by 1.

Soul Eater.text: Devour and Harvester grant double mana. Decreases maximum marks by 1.

Kelight's Shield.lore: Used by the Temple of the Legends' strongest guard, the shielded plating is enchanted with a powerful ward to stave off the effects of the corruption.

Keratoconus.lore: The unearthly wood of eyestalk is durable, but with horrific cost. Pieces severed from the trunk continue to collect and cultivate the essence of abandoned eyes, and the unfortunate wearer becomes a catalyst for growth.

Ketenya Izul.lore: Masks were carved in his honor, tributes to a chief whose heart of stone was a symbol of boundless, fearless strength. How cruel, then, that when the madness took him, that heart kept its vow to the very end. It warded off death and warded off remorse, leaving behind a monster as cold and unyielding as the cairn in his chest.

Knee.lore: "I thought aiming for the legs would disable the enemy. Turns out they can drag themselves with their arms just as quick." -Therck, Ragni Soldier 3rd Division

Knucklebones.lore: An old Nemract saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."

Kratke.lore: Spurred on by a drunken bet, the great Thanos smith Kratke improved a pair of leggings from a rival that were once thought to be perfection.

Labyrinth.lore: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right. Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

majorIds.Twisting Threads: Tangled Traps ropes gain +1 range, can overlap up to 3 times, and deal 65%. Gain +12 traps with 66% duration that cannot be triggered by enemies.

Twisting Threads.text: Tangled Traps ropes gain +1 range, can overlap up to 3 times, and deal
. Gain +12 traps with 66% duration that cannot be triggered by enemies.

Lament.lore: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

Last Stand.lore: You're the only one left. The only light remaining to lift this world out of endless night. Push on; one day, you may make it.

Last Sun.lore: The falling sun shall be your demise.

majorIds.Lockdown: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

Lockdown.text: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

Latent Disorder.lore: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.

majorIds.Chaos Reach: Blood Sorrow spends 20 less points of Blood Pool and inflicts enemies with 0.3 seconds of Bleeding per hit, but no longer grants overhealth.

Chaos Reach.text: Blood Sorrow spends 20 less points of Blood Pool and inflicts enemies with 0.3 seconds of Bleeding per hit, but no longer grants overhealth.

Law of the Jungle.lore: An uncountably old relic of Time Valley which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'

Legendary Medallion.lore: This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.

Legendary Smasher.lore: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

Lemon Legs.lore: Due to an unfortunate accident where he choked on a lemon, an unremarkable mercenary became a laughing stock. He later managed to shed the title, as he left no one alive who remembered the name.

Leo.lore: This thick skinned jacket, imbued with the courage of a thousand lion hearts, will grant the user massive protection from all who target them.

Libertas.lore: Break free. Free from the constraints of the flesh, free from the constraints of the mind, free from the constraints of the self.

Libra.lore: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in Cinfras. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.

Light of The Wings.lore: "Against all heed, to Fruma eternal." The engraving appears extremely weathered.

Lingering Twilight.lore: In the harshest reaches of the mountains, dusk brings a gentle magic to the air, prolonging the faintest vestiges of sundown before night truly falls.

Little Inferno.lore: It is cold to the touch until worn. Once donned, it engulfs the wearer in excruciatingly hot flames, but never shall the wearer burn; only their enemies will feel the pain of the fire.

Living Slime.lore: It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.

Locrian.lore: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

Lodestone.lore: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.

Lost Seconds.lore: This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.

Lost Tales.lore: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.

Lower.lore: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

Lozendu Haon.lore: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.

Lucky Strike.lore: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.

majorIds.Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -10%.

Juggle.text: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by

Luminis.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Lunacy.lore: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.

Lunar Acropolis.lore: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.

Lunar Spine.lore: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

Lurking Peril.lore: The dense, frostbitten trees hide danger at every step, too far to see yet too close to escape.

majorIds.Lunge: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Lunge.text: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Lustrum.lore: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.

Macabre.lore: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of Ragni

Machinations.lore: You'll connive, coerce, lure them in and control it all. Until all cards are set, all pieces in place. Then, when they've all exhausted their usefulness...

Maelstrom.lore: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

Malevolent Urge.lore: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Sorcery.text: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Malocchio.lore: Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.

Maltic's Old Spear.lore: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.

Marionette.lore: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

Strings of Fate.text: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

Marius' Prison.lore: "I know the Beast may return one day...but these chains shall bind it for eternity." The inscription glows bright in the darkness.

Mark of the Huntsman.lore: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.

majorIds.Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Seeking Module.text: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Martingale.lore: Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure-it will all be worth in the end.

Martyr.lore: A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.

Marvel.lore: The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.

Mask of the Spirits.lore: Not all who roam may find their way home. Others lose themselves in the world... And find a new way forward.

Masochist.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Master.lore: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.

Masterwork Aftershock.lore: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

Masterwork Apocalypse.lore: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

Masterwork Archangel.lore: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

Masterwork Az.lore: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

majorIds.Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

Masterwork Cataclysm.lore: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

Masterwork Epoch.lore: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.

Masterwork Fatal.lore: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

majorIds.Unstable Reaction: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

Unstable Reaction.text: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

Masterwork Guardian.lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

majorIds.Heroine's Blessing: Devout Union gains +25% damage redirection and +8 radius. Additionally, Mantles given by Enlightenment have +20% damage reduction.

Heroine's Blessing.text: Devout Union gains +25% damage redirection and +8 radius. Additionally, Mantles given by Enlightenment have +20% damage reduction.

Masterwork Idol.lore: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

majorIds.Tidal Drift: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

Tidal Drift.text: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

Masterwork Immolation.lore: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

majorIds.Blazing Effigy: Regeneration increases Totem's damage by +14% +6% instead of restoring health.

Masterwork Lament.lore: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

majorIds.Requiem: Sunflare regenerates twice the health and mana.

Requiem.text: Sunflare regenerates twice the health and mana.

Masterwork Nirvana.lore: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.

majorIds.Enlightenment: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana and instead refund 25% of their original cost.

Enlightenment.text: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana and instead refund 25% of their original cost.

Masterwork Olympic.lore: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

Lightweight.text: You no longer take fall damage.

Masterwork Pure.lore: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

Cosmic Capture.text: Meteor falls twice as fast, has +3 blast radius, and pulls enemies upon impact.

Masterwork Singularity.lore: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

Masterwork Stratiformis.lore: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

Elven Current.text: Escape can be re-cast twice in mid-air.

Match.lore: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer

Matryoshka Shell.lore: The armor worn by the enigmatic Matryoshka Idol. It appears to have a nearly uncountably high number of inlets and sockets set inside.

Maul.lore: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion

Mazeweaver.lore: The strong can hammer foe and nature alike into submission, waging war with indiscriminate force. The truly powerful pit them against each other on a whim, weaving stone and verdure into an elaborate web of attrition that beats with the heart of an entire world. What is an enemy compared to all the might of the Earth?

Meanderthal.lore: These boots were retrieved from a frozen man, uncovered on an expedition to Mt. Wynn. It is believed that the man had been wandering the world before his death.

Megalophobia.lore: Each level deeper into the ocean only harbors stranger and more eerie creatures than before. Though their alien nature is disquieting, it is the way the trend sees no end that worries you the most.

Meikyo Shisui.lore: Troubled water shatters the moon into fleeing silver; still water holds it whole. So a clear mind reflects the truth undistorted- and lets the enemy's wrath come like a sword to water.

majorIds.Entropy: Meteor's speed is increased by 50%.

Memento.lore: All those who wear these enchanted boots deposit a single fond memory into them. They are forgotten forever, but wearing them recalls every memory within vividly.

Mephistophelian.lore: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.

Mesarock Arch.lore: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.

Mesmerizing Madness.lore: Sink into infinite synchronous beats with the intricate rhythm of fractals and spirals and patterns, and patterns, and patterns that reach to the pulsating stars and then back to the ground where the people are dancing to songs they don't know under stars that turn ‘round, and around, and around, as the spiral is starting again . . .

Mesoskeleton.lore: Ancient bones, fractured by corruption and the elements, have twisted themselves into these leggings. The armor shifts to fit its wearer before turning the bones inwards, inflicting unending agony.

Metamorphosis.lore: What you have seen will mark you forever.

Miasma.lore: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, Almuj resident

Millennium.lore: Cosmic energy permeates this deceptively dull-looking chestplate, having been crafted with stardust from a comet that only passes over Wynn every 1000 years.

Minokawa's Grasp.lore: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.

majorIds.Sun Eater: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

Sun Eater.text: Failing to backstab an enemy from behind blinds them for 0.5s and slows them by 20% for 5s.

Misshapen Libella.lore: It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.

Mistweb Spinner.lore: To hunt in the Mistwoods is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.

Molten Fleshmass.lore: The scorching heat, the shifting bodies, the screeching cries of anguish... they're all the least of your problems now.

majorIds.Temblor: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Temblor.text: Bash gains +1 Area of Effect and is 0.05s faster.

Momentum.lore: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.

majorIds.Hurricane's Eye: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

Hurricane's Eye.text: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

Monster.lore: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

Moonscorched Amulet.lore: Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.

Moontower.lore: For the belief of the cosmos' defilement, the moon was noted to remain unchanged. Those with this belief live only for the light of the moon, desperately seeking to maintain it through means that would only darken the soul of the most devout. Such from them comes the word lunacy.

Morrowind.lore: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

Mothwing Cloak.lore: Threaded with strands of silk from a giant moth, it allows the wearer to dash through the air.

majorIds.Lunge: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Lunge.text: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Mud.lore: "Some pigmen snuffle through dirt for things to eat. We dig up that soil to plant our crops in; it's always full of life." -Thomas, Ravine Village Resident

Mummy's Rag.lore: The accursed mummy once wore this robe as a great pharaoh of the desert. It has long since rotted, leaving only a cursed shell of its former greatness.

Mummy's Talisman.lore: Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.

Mutilated Corpse.lore: Freshly slain foes in well below freezing conditions often provide enough warmth to weather the storm. However, this Corrupted seems to still be alive in some sickening way, draining life force to sustain itself.

Myopia.lore: In such a sinister and wicked expanse, one wonders if the best solution is to give up your eyes and replace them with a pair that does not indulge in such evils, cleansing them from your idyllic field of view while the wider world around you withers away.

Narcissist.lore: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

majorIds.Geocentrism: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Geocentrism.text: Aura radiates from you instead of your Totem and can be cast any time.

Necklace of a Thousand Storms.lore: Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.

Necrosis.lore: 450 years ago a demonic plague like no other spread through Gavel, killing thousands. That is, until a priest encased the disease inside a helmet and warned everyone never to wear it.

Nemract's Rage.lore: A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.

Nemract's Ruin.lore: This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of Ancient Nemract before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for Nemract's guard.

Neolithic.lore: This ancient stone-hewn helmet is blended with the bones of an extinct animal of some kind. It is harder than dragon's hide.

Nepta Floodbringer.lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

Nether's Scar.lore: Forged directly from the bloody red stone mined from the Nether, they were locked away for fear of inciting insanity in those who wore them.

Nexus.lore: Where thought converges, the veil thins.

Nitrogen.lore: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.

Nonexistence.lore: What lies beneath the brim of all that never was, that overflowing vastness which cannot spill?

Nostalgia.lore: It once held little meaning, another lilac left unnoticed in the quotidian meadows of yesteryear. Yet just its scent brings forth a deluge of memory, crashing down with the force of a time long past.

Nova.lore: There is a certain fascination to what lies beyond our grasp, to the spaces we cannot quite see. Harness that pull, draw in your foe, bend it to your will. What could go wrong?

Null Space.lore: What's the point of your journey if it all just leads to nothing?

Nullification.lore: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.

majorIds.Punishment: Reflected damage blinds enemies for 1s and makes them 10% more vulnerable to attacks for 3s.

Punishment.text: Reflected damage blinds enemies for 1s and makes them 10% more vulnerable to attacks for 3s.

Oblivion.lore: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

Obsidian-Framed Helmet.lore: Made of dark minerals and adorned with pure obsidian, this ornately-crafted helmet is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Obsolescent Panoply.lore: A silhouette of forgotten strength, its essence lingering like a half remembered dream. It no longer boasts the sharpness it once had, yet the stories etched into its very being refuse to fade.

Obstinance.lore: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it-"

Occultation.lore: This ornate knife, which fell from Ahmsord centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.

Ohms' Rage.lore: These ancient, spark-coursing greaves are all that remains of the great thunder mage Ohms' favorite golem familiar after a dark force turned it against its masters.

Ohms' Wish.lore: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.

Old Keeper's Ring.lore: Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.

majorIds.Greed: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Greed.text: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Olux's Prized Bow.lore: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

Olux's Prized Dagger.lore: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.

Olux's Prized Relik.lore: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

Olux's Prized Spear.lore: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.

Olux's Prized Wand.lore: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

Omnitread Boots.lore: Plated with enchanted metals, these magic-warding boots allow faster travel over nearly any solid surface.

Opulenity.lore: Made of an uncommonly used fabric called denim, these fashionable leggings exude style and elegance. Surely wearing them would bring you luck?

Orange Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "ORANGE you glad I showed up for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

majorIds.Freerunner: When your sprint bar is under 30% full, increase your sprint speed by +150%.

Freerunner.text: When your sprint bar is under 30% full, increase your sprint speed by +150%.

Orogenesis.lore: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.

Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendar.lore: This perfect-to-the-point-of-indistinguishability replica mask of Herbert von Legendary's face, painstakingly crafted by Corkus's most powerful machines with only the most expensive materials and featuring real moustache hair plucked from Doctor Legendary's face, is desperately handed over to attempt to placate those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession for spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Outrage.lore: This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.

Overdrive.lore: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--

Oyster.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Pain Cycle.lore: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?

Panic Zealot.lore: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

majorIds.Furious Effigy: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Furious Effigy.text: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Panopticon.lore: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.

majorIds.Superconductor: Chain Lightning channels three massive lightning bolts through you, arcing to enemies within 8 blocks for 270% and stunning them for 1s. You take 10% more damage for 4s.

Pareidolia.lore: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.

Pas De Deux.lore: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."

majorIds.Aubri's Tears: Pool of Rejuvenation's range and duration are doubled, but Frog Dance deals no damage.

Aubri's Tears.text: Pool of Rejuvenation's range and duration are doubled, but Frog Dance deals no damage.

Passus Lux.lore: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.

majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

Lightweight.text: You no longer take fall damage.

Pelier.lore: Occasional whisperings can be heard by the wearers of this stone mask, reforged from a phylactery of souls. Although not dangerous, staring into the eyes of the mask can bring fear of one's soul being trapped within.

Perch of the Shrouded Sun.lore: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.

Petal Blade.lore: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.

Petrichor.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Petulance.lore: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

Phage Pins.lore: Salvaged from the limbs of the Vulcor Adrenophage, they radiate extreme heat, suffusing the body they attach to with that same heat. It almost feels as though your blood is heating to a frenetic boil.

Phanerozoic.lore: An age of transformation. To shape the evolution of life, as if molding a piece of clay. To gain intelligence, and become the harbingers of creation and destruction. To build control, and become the hand of fate. Here, we begin.

Phantasmal Hostage.lore: A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.

Phantasmal Remnants.lore: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

majorIds.Alter Ego: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

Alter Ego.text: Awakened can be activated after saving 40% less mana, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

Philosopher.lore: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?

majorIds.Peaceful Effigy: Your Totem will last twice as long.

Peaceful Effigy.text: Your Totem will last twice as long.

Phlebotomy.lore: Rivers will run red in your wake.

majorIds.Cannulate: Sacrificial Shrine costs -5 Blood Pool to cast and health drain is halved.

Cannulate.text: Sacrificial Shrine costs -5 Blood Pool to cast and health drain is halved.

Phoenix Prince's Crown.lore: The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.

Phoenix Wing.lore: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.

Pine Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

Pink Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Going HAM on Craftmas dinner tonight" knitted onto the front.

Pisces.lore: The oddly uncomfortable helmet was hand sculpted from a mystic clay found only in the depths of Molten Heights. Not much is known about the substance.

Plague Staff.lore: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

majorIds.Plague: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Plague.text: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Planet Buster.lore: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.

Planet Healer.lore: The jewels in this necklace naturally draw darkness and corruption into its wearer, purifying the land around them at the cost of their own life.

Platonic Ideal.lore: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.

majorIds.Heartbeat: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

Heartbeat.text: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

Pollution.lore: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?

Possession.lore: Your mind is falling apart, the pieces scattering, your grasp on reality weakening, your soul an empty space. I shall fill it.

majorIds.Spectral Memory: Ghostly Trigger lasts until landing, but no longer increases attack speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Spectral Memory.text: Ghostly Trigger lasts until landing, but no longer increases attack speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Post-Ultima.lore: These leggings are the last remaining piece of a historical set of armor, created with such power as to be thought impossible long ago.

Precious.lore: A strange magic attracts you to this ring. Maybe you shouldn't tell anyone about its existence?

Prism.lore: The jewel on this ring is found very rarely deep beneath the Light Forest. It has the power to manipulate light itself.

Pristine Antiquity.lore: Smooth yet unassuming, this hollowed piece feels as if it lay untouched for millennia as the chaos that formed eastern Gavel unfolded around it. No blemish nor order, just nature preserved in its most perfect form.

Procrastination.lore: ...I'll finish writing this later.

majorIds.Peaceful Effigy: Your Totem will last twice as long.

Peaceful Effigy.text: Your Totem will last twice as long.

Propeller Hat.lore: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."

majorIds.Windsurf: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.

Windsurf.text: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.
