Self-sufficient.text: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Protector's Parable.lore: A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.

Proterozoic.lore: An age of oxidation. To assert that you will remain, and others all across the world will be left behind. To overwhelm everything with toxic air, ensuring that extinctions follow your wake. Some stop breathing, but the gears of time march on.

Protoplasm.lore: Before the first breath was drawn from the open air, there was the slow, pulsing warmth of the deep. To walk the earth is to invite suffering into brittle bones, trading an eternal sanctuary for a world of choking dust and the aimless howling of the wind.

Provenance.lore: Your success heralds the beginning of something new.

Prowess.lore: The runes carved into this simple gold cuff translate into various words meaning mastery. It amplifies the ability of the wearer in mysterious ways.

Proxima.lore: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.

Prymari.lore: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.

majorIds.Expunge: When using Heal, cast one instant pulse that heals 15% of your max health.

Expunge.text: When using Heal, cast one instant pulse that heals 15% of your max health.

Pulsar.lore: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.

Pulse Storm.lore: In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.

Puppeteer.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Pure.lore: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

majorIds.Gravity Well: Meteor has increased blast radius and pulls enemies instead.

Gravity Well.text: Meteor has increased blast radius and pulls enemies instead.

Purity Filter.lore: Originally intended to remove corruption from the world in small amounts, the item became ineffective after overuse. Traces of corruption linger in the metal, displaying the futility of attempting such a feat.

Purple Prose.lore: Your disputatious adversaries blanch at your consummate pugnacious ability, and, naturally, your superlative nous.

Purple Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" knitted onto the front.

Putrid.lore: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

Pyrexia.lore: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

majorIds.Gentle Glow: Orphion's Pulse restores 10% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

Gentle Glow.text: Orphion's Pulse restores 10% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

Queen Bee's Call.lore: A single insect is simple. Perhaps lost, perhaps helpless. But their purpose is immutable over all. If they are to be summoned, then they are to stand. If they are to be asked the impossible, then they are to strike regardless.

majorIds.Mob Mentality: Commander places puppets ahead of where you are facing.

Mob Mentality.text: Commander places puppets ahead of where you are facing.

Quetzalcoatl.lore: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.

Quilted Carapace.lore: This patchwork of shells from the Corkian Astrochelys makes for quite the statement sweater; it keeps your neck warm and besides, your foes' fashion fancies feel frivolous, anyway.

majorIds.Transcendence: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana when casted.

Transcendence.text: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana when casted.

Ra.lore: Undecipherable symbols are carved into this long arm band, though the fiery glow and bright jewel has led archaeologists to believe it is somehow related to the sun.

Radiation.lore: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.

Radium.lore: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.

Ragni's Mail.lore: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over 1000 years ago.

Rainbow Sanctuary.lore: The harmony of the elements, a world which sings its truth for all who dare listen, words spoken which can be felt but never known. The Sanctuary, in its whole.

Rarity.lore: Being one of the absolute rarest treasures in the world, it seems to have a mind of its own, only showing itself when a stroke of luck is had.

Reaper of Soul.lore: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.

Recalcitrance.lore: "The omens, the warnings, they were right there, and we stood by and did nothing."

Reckoning.lore: Come to terms with your godlike judgment.

Recursion.lore: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

Red Candle.lore: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

Red Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" knitted onto the front.

Regal Sceptre.lore: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.

Relic.lore: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

Reliquiae.lore: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.

majorIds.Rusted Ichor: Boiling Blood cooldown is reduced by 0.5s and inflicts 40% slowness, but deals no damage.

Rusted Ichor.text: Boiling Blood cooldown is reduced by 0.5s and inflicts 40% slowness, but deals no damage.

Remikas' Authority.lore: This plain-looking silver bracer is one of the last surviving heirlooms of the first Gavellian king, to be passed down to his heirs. The shimmering metal is said to contain Remikas' soul within it.

Remikas' Righteousness.lore: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.

Renascence.lore: No more dreams. Not after what you've been through.

Renegade.lore: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.

Renegade Bomber.lore: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."

Repose.lore: Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.

Repurposed Vessels.lore: When the Colossus they called Protector raised its sword, splintering the land like glass, the void opened its jaws to swallow the world. Earthenware dredged from the abyss were reshaped into pieces of armor. They pull at your heels like leaden anchors, and carry the strength of bedrock.

majorIds.Dead Weight: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

Dead Weight.text: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

Resolution.lore: In the moments before an all but inescapable death, time slows down, and the pace of battle becomes yours. By mastering the escape, you can face death on command, reaping the benefits at will before the reaper reaches you.

Resonance.lore: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.

majorIds.Lifestream: Blood Sorrow has 4 times the damage and overhealth, but its duration is shortened by 75%.

Lifestream.text: Blood Sorrow has 4 times the damage and overhealth, but its duration is shortened by 75%.

Resurgence.lore: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of Efilim. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.

Net Shot.text: Bryophyte Roots is now triggered from Buckshot, doubling its slowness and damage.

Reticence.lore: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.

Retired Vigour.lore: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.

Return to Ether.lore: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.

Revenant.lore: Those whose souls are lost to the Canyon of the Lost eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.

Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory.internalName: Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory
Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory.lore: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Reverence.lore: A molten bracer decorated with royal ornaments, it exudes an aura of uncontested superiority. Indeed, wearing it breeds only admiration from the masses who stand below you, fueling your rise to the top.

Reversion.lore: Look at the road behind you. The familiar warmth of your journey proves you haven't forgotten your roots, and the familiar faces still standing by your side proves that they are here to stay.

Reviled Saviour.lore: You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.

Revolution.lore: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.

majorIds.Regicide: You deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

Regicide.text: You deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

Rewind.lore: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Sorcery.text: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Rewritten History.lore: Alter your past to reshape your future.

Rhyolitic Wrath.lore: A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.

Rhythm of the Seasons.lore: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.

majorIds.Rally: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Rally.text: Cleansing Breeze heals you for 15% and allies for 20%, but Charge becomes harmless.

Ribcage.lore: "...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan

Rigor Mortis.lore: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.

Rikter.lore: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.

Riptide.lore: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.

Royal Blazing Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It glows with a comforting warmth.

Royal Cyclone Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It whistles with an invigorating tune.

Royal Dusty Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It shines with a powerful strength.

Royal Shocking Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It crackles with a chaotic energy.

Royal Stormy Amulet.lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It pulsates with a calming aura.

Ruinous.lore: To fight for a cause so overwhelmingly greater than themselves, under that lofty, unreachable banner. What will they do if it all comes crumbling down; when beliefs and ideals rot away, reduced to naught but ash?

Runebound Chains.lore: You know better than anyone else that there's always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Sorcery.text: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Rycar's Elation.lore: Created from the lip of a wine bottle and dropped in the mystic waters of Lake Gylia, this glass ring seems to follow Rycar's drunken escapades wherever she wanders.

Sacrilege.lore: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.

Sage.lore: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for 10 years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.

Sagittarius.lore: The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.

Samsara.lore: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?

majorIds.Mana Surge: Curse instead releases a calming wave with a radius of 8 blocks. Allies affected will have their Mana Regen and Mana Steal increased by 25% for 6s.

Mana Surge.text: Curse instead releases a calming wave with a radius of 8 blocks. Allies affected will have their Mana Regen and Mana Steal increased by 25% for 6s.

Sanguine Spaulder.lore: Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.

Sanies.lore: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, Nemract Militia

Sawdust.lore: Once cursed by a druid who had his grove chopped away by a greedy Villager, it was then purified and mass-produced for sale as armor, to the druid's utter disappointment.

Scarlet Veil.lore: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.

majorIds.Explosive Impact: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

Scarlet Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" knitted onto the front.

Scattered Psyche.lore: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.

majorIds.Furious Effigy: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Furious Effigy.text: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Schadenfreude.lore: It's a wicked dream come true-their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

Strings of Fate.text: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

Scorched Antiquity.lore: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.

Scorched Feather.lore: The world is at your fingertips. Don't reach too far.

Scorpio.lore: The carapace of the common Maexi pet fire scarabs, while alone, only cause minor burns to the touch. However, when woven together, they produce a variety of cumulative effects.

Scorpion.lore: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.

Scrap Cannon.lore: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.

Scumlord.lore: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?

majorIds.Backstep: Charge and Teleport will travel backwards.

Backstep.text: Charge and Teleport will travel backwards.

Scythe.lore: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.

Sea of Fire.lore: An oasis of flame, where noone can hurt you. Through abhorrence and loathing, you may create a world where all things burn, and a perfectly beautiful world it will be indeed.

Seal Breaker.lore: Seek the opportune moment. Every wall has a crack that opens when the pressure shifts. Strike decisively when the light seeps through. The treasure will be yours.

Sealight Prism.lore: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.

majorIds.Lustrate: Heal restores health at a slower rate, but Searing Light deals +150%.

Secondsaver.lore: Seize the fleeting moment. Every tick of the clock is priceless, so pack every second with thrill, action, and laughter, and live the day to the fullest.

majorIds.Self-sufficient: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Self-sufficient.text: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Sepulchral Shackles.lore: The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.

Serene Storm.lore: Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.

Serpent's Kiss.lore: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, Maltic Escort

Seven-League Boots.lore: Bending the fabric of reality to allow the wearer to take massive strides, these boots are rumored to contain rogue djinni to power them.

majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

Lightweight.text: You no longer take fall damage.

Shamash.lore: A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.

Shattered Aurora.lore: The shifting mosaic that graces the winter skies has always struck you as a faint trace of some grand precursor, pure and whole. As you look up at what remains, fragmented beyond the horizon, you can't help but wonder what it would take to break it once more.

Shattered Horizon.lore: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?

majorIds.Entropy: Meteor's speed is increased by 50%.

Shatterglass.lore: This small, rough-crafted pendant is the only known magic artifact of the Orcs. It incites destructive tendencies within the wearer.

Shawl of Gaea.lore: Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.

Shine Suffocator.lore: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.

Shinespark.lore: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in Llevigar, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.

Shogun.lore: The law of the ancients was clear on the matter. The law of the jungle was, too. Tradition and nature agree: power can only be held by those with the strength to wield it.

Shredder Club.lore: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."

Sigil of Existence.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

majorIds.Taunt: Provoke's Cooldown is reduced to 8s but its duration is reduced to 3s.

Taunt.text: Provoke's Cooldown is reduced to 8s but its duration is reduced to 3s.

Silicon.lore: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.

Silk Slasher.lore: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, Detlas 2nd Regiment

Silver Fiber Bracelet.lore: This rough looking bracelet utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains a whispering.

Silver Fiber Necklace.lore: This crude looking necklace utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains quiet.

Silver Fiber Ring.lore: This crude looking ring utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains a whispering.

Silver Fusion Bracelet.lore: This bracelet, decorated with simple ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. There are many upgrades to be made before it reaches its full potential.

Silver Fusion Necklace.lore: This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. There are many upgrades to be made before it reaches its full potential.

Silver Fusion Ring.lore: This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a strong elemental affinity in you. With some improvements to its core, it could become even better...

Silver Hydro Bracelet.lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

Silver Hydro Necklace.lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

Silver Hydro Ring.lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

Silver Solar Bracelet.lore: The device forged into this simple bracelet seems to gather heat. You feel a bit lukewarm when wearing it...

Silver Solar Necklace.lore: The device forged into this basic necklace seems to gather heat. You can feel a warm sting when holding it.

Silver Solar Ring.lore: The device forged into this simple ring seems to absorb heat. You feel a bit lukewarm when wearing it...

Silver Static Bracelet.lore: Though it's hard to touch the simple, mechanical bracelet without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

Silver Static Necklace.lore: Though it's hard to touch the plain, tech-enhanced necklace without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

Silver Static Ring.lore: Though it's hard to touch the plain, mechanical ring without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

Silver Steam Bracelet.lore: Users who have worn this early model of the Steam Bracelet have reported that they have felt "one with the wind" while wearing it.

Silver Steam Necklace.lore: Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from this necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all. However, the necklace's mechanisms seem incomplete.

Silver Steam Ring.lore: This prototype model of the Steam Ring increases the user's agility in combat. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.

Simulacrum.lore: An anomaly of replication, for the assemblers who seek purpose outside of reality.

majorIds.Meteor Crash: Burning Sigil gains +6 radius and deals 4x the damage, but lasts half as long.

Meteor Crash.text: Burning Sigil gains +6 radius and deals 4x the damage, but lasts half as long.

Singularity.lore: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

majorIds.Orbital Chain: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a 8000% explosion spell.

Sitis.lore: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.

Skeetwing Jewel.lore: Buzzing betwixt the muck and mire.

majorIds.Culicidae Creed: Leap becomes fully vertical, and Spectral Hover lasts twice as long.

Culicidae Creed.text: Leap becomes fully vertical, and Spectral Hover lasts twice as long.

Sketiq.lore: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, Katoa Ranch Farmer

Skin Piercer.lore: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.

Skull Breaker.lore: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, Ragni Citizen

Skyfall.lore: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.

Skyline Bliss.lore: The sky knows no bounds.

majorIds.Pirouette: Dancing Blade enhances Dash. Dashing into an enemy now vaults you upwards and resets dash as if you touched the ground.

Pirouette.text: Dancing Blade enhances Dash. Dashing into an enemy now vaults you upwards and resets dash as if you touched the ground.

Slayer.lore: Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.

Slaying Moon.lore: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.

Slider.lore: The spelling seems to have been botched.

Sludge Slicer.lore: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.

Snowtread Boots.lore: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter where one walks with them.

majorIds.Snowy Steps: Leaves a trail of snow behind you.

Snowy Steps.text: Leaves a trail of snow behind you.

Sodeta Boots.lore: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

Sol.lore: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs. Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper

Song of Solitude.lore: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.

majorIds.Pioneer's Echo: Phantom Ray deals 7x damage, but only hits twice over 1 second. Decimator's increase and cap are raised to 140% and Quick Draw's activation threshold is decreased to 2.

Pioneer's Echo.text: Phantom Ray deals 7x damage, but only hits twice over 1 second. Decimator's increase and cap are raised to 140% and Quick Draw's activation threshold is decreased to 2.

Song of the Sea.lore: A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.

Sonic Wave.lore: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.

majorIds.Power Fist: Striking enemies with an empty hand greatly knocks them back.

Power Fist.text: Striking enemies with an empty hand greatly knocks them back.

Soul Ink.lore: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the Kander Forest.

Soul Unmade.lore: Your mind is ripped away from reality, puppeting the ghost of a vessel that once held your brilliant spirit. But here, now, you can do things you never before thought possible. They cannot touch you here, here in the realm where the shadows live.

majorIds.Intangible: The knockback you take is drastically reduced, and reflected damage deals large knockback.

Intangible.text: The knockback you take is drastically reduced, and reflected damage deals large knockback.

Soundwave.lore: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.

Span of the Starfield.lore: Infinitesimal specks of matter wane in and out of view among the darkness of this clasp. Even a glance reminds you of what little exists in the expanses of the Void from which the materials of this were scavenged from.

Spectral Psalm.lore: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.

majorIds.Strings of Fate: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

Strings of Fate.text: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.

Spectre.lore: The dark spectres of the decayed forests have created an insidious helmet to drain the spirit of those who wear it, and become servants to their dark whims. Many have fallen to its allure.

Spider Ring.lore: "Crawly things. They crawl on the mushrooms. Mushrooms shouldn't be crawly!" -Yahya, Mushroom Man

Spinneret.lore: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

Spiritshock.lore: Recovered from the Lexdale Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.

Spring.lore: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

majorIds.Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.

Springtrap.lore: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, Almuj Archaeologist

Sprout.lore: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead." -Caras, Owl Tribesman

Squall's Breath.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

Stabsand.lore: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.

Stalagmites.lore: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.

Stale.lore: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

Starcaller.lore: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

majorIds.Solar Wind: Thunderstorm disables Meteor, grants +3 thunderbolts, +3 radius and deals 100% and 110% each. Unstable now activates on Thunderstorm for 400% bonus damage.

Solar Wind.text: Thunderstorm disables Meteor, grants +3 thunderbolts, +3 radius and deals
each. Unstable now activates on Thunderstorm for 400% bonus damage.

Stardew.lore: Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.

Stargazing Lens.lore: A single vibrant star sits at the focus of the mirror. Though, faintly, many more sit in the perimeter of the view... perhaps they mean something?

Static Cling.lore: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.

Stave of the Legends.lore: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.

Steadfast.lore: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.

majorIds.Rock Shield: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

Rock Shield.text: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

Steamjet Walkers.lore: A rogue inventor stole the plans for a steam jet booster from Corkus and reverse engineered them onto a set of boots. While effective, they are dangerous, prone to catastrophic failure.

majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

Lightweight.text: You no longer take fall damage.

Stellar.lore: Elementally attuned gemstones are melded together to form the singular marvel found on this pendant. Despite the violent smithing process, the jewel is utterly flawless.

Sticky Decoder Ring.lore: Each one is welded stuck to just one letter. Apparently, to decode the special Rymek message, you need to buy twenty six. ...do they think you're a fool?

Stifling Spores.lore: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...

majorIds.Plague: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Plague.text: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Sting.lore: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher

Stinger.lore: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...

Stingy.lore: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, Ragni Legion 1st Division

Stoneheart.lore: The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul

Stratiformis.lore: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

Stratosphere.lore: Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless-caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.

majorIds.Taunt: Provoke's Cooldown is reduced to 8s but its duration is reduced to 3s.

Taunt.text: Provoke's Cooldown is reduced to 8s but its duration is reduced to 3s.

Stronghold.lore: The cost of survival is immense, with morale running thin and supply lines choked, feeding the strength of an army condensed to a single point, of a people desperate not to give an inch.

Stygian Spiral.lore: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?

majorIds.River of Souls: Phantom Ray gains massive radius, but reduced damage by 20%.

River of Souls.text: Phantom Ray gains massive radius, but reduced damage by 20%.

Styx's Grab.lore: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, Nemract Conscript

Substrate.lore: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.

Succession.lore: "I pray that those who have heeded the wise one's warning have survived. The canyon must not meet this fate."

Sulfur Expulser.lore: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.

Summa.lore: An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-4M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.

Sunstar.lore: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.

Surveillance.lore: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force. Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

Suspended Soliloquy.lore: No one can hold you down anymore.

majorIds.Inversion: Teleport will grant you 3 seconds of levitation.

Inversion.text: Teleport will grant you 3 seconds of levitation.

Sweeping Majesty.lore: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.

Sweet Memories.lore: The feel of cool cream. The savory satisfaction of fatty stew. The bittersweetness of chocolate. Luxuries long since lost alongside what once was, tastes and sensations you can't find anymore. It's enough to bring a man to bitter, bitter tears.

Swindler's Charm.lore: This relic has been passed down through the ages, from conman to charlatan to chiseller. It grants an inexplicable sense of candor to your words.

Symbiont.lore: Survival is the shared interest of those in the wilds.

Symphonie Fantastique.lore: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.

Syncope.lore: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

majorIds.Heat Shimmer: Foul Play will no longer slay a Mirror Clone and will still provide its effects, but Mirror Clone count is reduced to 1. Tricks application is increased by 50%.

majorIds.Escape Route: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

Escape Route.text: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

Tachypsychia.lore: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

majorIds.Furious Effigy: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Furious Effigy.text: Totem effects are twice as fast, but duration is halved.

Taciturn.lore: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.

Tactician.lore: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.

majorIds.Battlefield Brilliance: Generalist instead makes your next Main Attack deal quadruple damage, followed by a tactical retreat.

Battlefield Brilliance.text: Generalist instead makes your next Main Attack deal quadruple damage, followed by a tactical retreat.

majorIds.Lunge: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Lunge.text: Hop and Leap's horizontal velocity is greatly increased.

Taurus.lore: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

Tautology.lore: It is what it is.

Tectonics.lore: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

majorIds.Fissure: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback, +275%, and +155%.

Fissure.text: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback,

Tempo Tanto.lore: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.

Tempo Ticker.lore: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.

Tempo Totem.lore: Andante. Like the gentle drift of the forest canopy, swaying in a timeless dance. An effigy defined by the steady rhythms of nature.

Tempo Trebuchet.lore: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.

Tempo Trident.lore: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.

Temporal Lantern.lore: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?

Ten-Foot Pole.lore: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

Tenacity.lore: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.

Tenuto.lore: This strange pendant has been known to dilate time around the wearer, slowing their movements while greatly augmenting their power.

Terminal Velocity.lore: Don't give them time for even a warning.

majorIds.Tackle: Flying Kick deals much more knockback and increases Collide damage by an additional 150%, 60%, and 10%.

The Berserk.lore: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.

The Berserker's Helm.lore: Worn by a terrible berserker during his fanatical rampage through the land, his rage permeates this horned blackiron helmet.

The Divide.lore: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.

The Eviscerator.lore: This item was named by someone from the community!

The Evolved.lore: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."

The Exile.lore: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the Molten Heights, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.

The Exploited.lore: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

majorIds.Greed: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Greed.text: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

The Extinguished.lore: Everything that's fallen down here has a purpose. Or at least, it used to. Being too far removed from said purpose will eventually smother it, but it can always be rekindled... and that's where you come in.

The Forgery.lore: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.

The Forsaken.lore: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."

The Incomprehensible.lore: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.

majorIds.Wormhole: Last Laugh instead casts Meteor. Malicious Mockery causes Meteor to apply 13 Trick stacks.

Wormhole.text: Last Laugh instead casts Meteor. Malicious Mockery causes Meteor to apply 13 Trick stacks.

The Jingling Jester.lore: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!

majorIds.Greed: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

Greed.text: Picking up emeralds heals you and nearby players for 8% max health.

The Peak.lore: Looking over the horizon, you suddenly realize the span of your journey. How far you've come. How far you'll go.

majorIds.Clamber: Wall Jump becomes a sheer vertical climb.

Clamber.text: Wall Jump becomes a sheer vertical climb.

The Scavenged.lore: To the victor go the spoils. To the swift, go the spoils of the victor.

majorIds.Escape Route: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

Escape Route.text: Frenzy and Time Dilation charge twice as fast but also decay twice as fast.

The Siren's Call.lore: "I have hope in me the likes of which you could never imagine, and despair the likes of which you shall never fathom. If I cannot satisfy the one, then I will indulge the other."

The Swarm.lore: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.

The Swordfish.lore: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.

The Watched.lore: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."

Third Eye.lore: The Bantisu monks have developed this enigmatic sigil in their years of meditation and study. It blesses the wearer with luck and powerful psionic ability.

majorIds.Perfect Recall: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

Perfect Recall.text: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

Thought Energy.lore: Limitless light fills the vast expanse of your mind. Harness even a fraction of its potential, and you can command a force to shake worlds.

Threshold of Consciousness.lore: The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.

Thriller.lore: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller

Thrunda Ripsaw.lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.

Thrundacrack.lore: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

Thunder Sanctuary.lore: The home of the storms, where the cramped clouds crackle and power surges in sharp bolts.

Thunderbolt.lore: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.

Tidebinder.lore: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.

Time Rift.lore: You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Sorcery.text: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

Timeline Split.lore: You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.

Timeskip.lore: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.

Tisaun's Proof.lore: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.

Tisaun's Valor.lore: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all 1000 enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.

Titanium Grievers.lore: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.

Titanomachia.lore: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.

majorIds.Dauntless Inferno: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing 150% each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.

Dauntless Inferno.text: Courage casts a series of 5 infernos that expand after the last, dealing
each, and grants 20% resistance instead of a damage boost.

Toaster.lore: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.

Torrential Tide.lore: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.

Totalitarian.lore: Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.

Toxic Spike.lore: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.

Toxoplasmosis.lore: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

majorIds.Outbreak: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding 4% of your Poison ID every 0.25s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a 6 block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.

Outbreak.text: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding 4% of your Poison ID every 0.25s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a 6 block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.

Trance.lore: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

majorIds.Fixate: Distortion decays at a halved rate and Devitalize effects are doubled. However, Distortion effects on abilities are reduced by 40% and Meteor Shower now requires +50% Distortion per Meteor.

Fixate.text: Distortion decays at a halved rate and Devitalize effects are doubled. However, Distortion effects on abilities are reduced by 40% and Meteor Shower now requires +50% Distortion per Meteor.

Transfiguration.lore: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.

majorIds.Flain Remnants: Destroying a Puppet with Friendly Fire calls forth a Remnant. (Max 5) Each Remnant lasts for 20 seconds, fires an explosive tracking projectile every second that deals 95%, and increases your Main Attack damage by 15%.

Transplanted Psyche.lore: There's a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you've never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won't you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.

Traumerei.lore: In sleep we are unfettered, unhindered by the choices we make. In dream we are unbound, set free to the limits of imagination.

Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Vict.internalName: Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Victory
Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Vict.lore: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Tremolo.lore: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays." -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit

majorIds.Dead Weight: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

Dead Weight.text: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

Trikaya.lore: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.

majorIds.Sublimation: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

Trouble Tamer.lore: Wait it out. Even the darkest storm clouds will eventually run out of rain if you give them enough time. Step back. Breathe. The sky clears on its own once the sun has had its say.

Tug of Fate.lore: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.

majorIds.Heartbeat: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

Heartbeat.text: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

Twilight-Gilded Cloak.lore: An ephemeral moment in time captured by sheer force of magic, this ornately-crafted cloak is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

Twin Minds.lore: It takes two voices to make harmony.

Umami.lore: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from Lutho who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.

Umbral Anchor.lore: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.

Uncanny Mirage.lore: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places. A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.

Unforeseen Ends.lore: It doesn't matter that you meant well.

Unspeakable.lore: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.

Upgraded Archpriest.lore: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?

Upgraded Cursed Bow.lore: "100% curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.

Upgraded Dark Needle.lore: The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.

Upgraded Echolocation.lore: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?

Upgraded Flare Blitz.lore: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.

Upgraded HellRaiser.lore: The blade is covered in tape that's been scribbled on in order to make it look fiery. This doesn't seem like a wise purchase.

Upgraded Long Bow.lore: Apparently, they thought to make a long bow better, they should make it longer. You can barely hold it.

Upgraded Lullaby.lore: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.

Upgraded Melange.lore: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.

Upgraded Phoenix.lore: According to the merchant, the wand is extra flammable, so that it can burn up and disappear with all the mages quicker.

Upgraded Radiance.lore: The craftsmanship on this bow is rather poor. The paint on the "crystals" is chipping...

Upgraded Scalpel.lore: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.

Upgraded Steel Buster.lore: It is significantly heavier than usual...you can't tell if that is good or not, in this case.

Upgraded Vartija.lore: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?

Upgraded Whisper.lore: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...

majorIds.Plague: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Plague.text: Poisoned mobs spread their poison to nearby mobs.

Used Wolf Paw.lore: It looks more like a dog paw to you, but you don't feel like risking your life arguing with the merchant.

Valse Vaincue.lore: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.

Vaward.lore: A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.

Venerated Gold Mask of Legendary Victory.internalName: Venerated Gold Mask of Legendary Victory
Venerated Gold Mask of Legendary Victory.lore: This excessively ornate decorative mask, moulded from 24 carat gold, is awarded to those who have both spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

Veneration.lore: Revel in the respect you've finally earned.

Vengeance.lore: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.

majorIds.Manic Edge: While vanished, lose 5% of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by 3% per mana lost from this effect, up to 70%.

Manic Edge.text: While vanished, lose 5% of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by 3% per mana lost from this effect, up to 70%.

Venison.lore: This ancient Elven sacrificial mask contains only a sliver of its previous magic, yet the blessing of the Elven god Entia still greatly empowers those who don it.

Ventus Tail.lore: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.

Verdant Branch.lore: The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif

Verglas Spirit.lore: "A little belief, and just a little spirit, can go a long way."

majorIds.Divine Honor: Increases the bonus from Radiance by 5%. Bash deals -15% per hit.

Vigilance.lore: Stackpeak hawks are known for their aggression towards adventurers approching their nests. However, under the hawks' hostility lies the instincts to protect the younglings from invaders.

Vilavud Os.lore: Your world crumbles around you even as your senses heighten. Get out while you still can.

majorIds.Flight Burst: Arrow Storm recoil is increased and activates while grounded.

Flight Burst.text: Arrow Storm recoil is increased and activates while grounded.

majorIds.Magnet: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

Magnet.text: Pulls items dropped by mobs towards you.

majorIds.Entropy: Meteor's speed is increased by 50%.

Virgo.lore: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.

Viridian.lore: An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.

Viscera Burst.lore: Innards, outwards.It's pulling towards something.

majorIds.Fallout: Bomb Arrow gains +7.5 range, +50%, severely increased recoil, and 25% self-damage.

Vitre.lore: "They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher

majorIds.Altruism: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Altruism.text: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

Wanderer's Purpose.lore: To look and say "I will go there," and to keep going until you find it...that's what's important.

majorIds.Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Seeking Module.text: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

Wanderlust.lore: Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.

Warchief.lore: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.

Warden.lore: "I've been wishin' I was dead for a long time."

majorIds.Lockdown: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

Lockdown.text: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

Warp.lore: The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.

Warsong.lore: Soldiers claim that the sounds of undead hordes are one of the most feared things to hear across Wynn. Wearing this ring, the gruesome cries of corrupted legions permanently echo throughout your mind.

majorIds.Vedette: Focus gets +10% damage per stack, but caps at 2. Crepuscular Ray can be cast at 2 Focus with decreased Focus drain, launching you into the air and immobilizing you.

Vedette.text: Focus gets +10% damage per stack, but caps at 2. Crepuscular Ray can be cast at 2 Focus with decreased Focus drain, launching you into the air and immobilizing you.

Water Sanctuary.lore: The depths of the seas, where the waves flow fierce and fast and wash away the agonies of the world.

Waves Raiser.lore: The mystery of the ocean's appearance has eluded scholars for centuries. It is believed that many years ago, warlocks used wands like this one in an attempt to submerge the world.

Weathered.lore: A relic of the past in Time Valley was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.

majorIds.Roving Assassin: Vanish will no longer block mana and health regeneration.

Roving Assassin.text: Vanish will no longer block mana and health regeneration.

Web Plate.lore: "I just need a little more spider silk to finish this vest!" -Lacrona, Detlas Tailor, found eaten by Nivla spiders

Web Spitter.lore: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, Ragni Botanist

Weighted Nimble Fingers.lore: The extra metal on the glove completely defeats the purpose... It's unclear why it was re-smithed like this.

Welder Cannon.lore: Warning - device in state of extreme disrepair. Operators may experience unstable output, resulting in severe heat production upsurges. Any damage to material will not be reimbursed, and users will not be compensated for any injuries, burns, or deaths caused by improper use.

majorIds.Evershot: Arrow Hurricane becomes a consistent, straight stream of arrows with a slower fire rate, dealing greater knockback and triple damage per arrow. Additionally, Arsenal Synergy requires 10 less arrows for each flint arrow.

Evershot.text: Arrow Hurricane becomes a consistent, straight stream of arrows with a slower fire rate, dealing greater knockback and triple damage per arrow. Additionally, Arsenal Synergy requires 10 less arrows for each flint arrow.

Whiplash.lore: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.

majorIds.Lasso: Grappling Hook, War Scream, and Uproot now pull enemies with much more force.

Lasso.text: Grappling Hook, War Scream, and Uproot now pull enemies with much more force.

majorIds.Hurricane's Eye: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

Hurricane's Eye.text: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

White Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "SNOW way Craftmas can be bad in this sweater" knitted onto the front.

Windborne.lore: Orders, cannonfire, calls for surrender-the wind carries all. To ride the winds is to harness the lifeblood of battle, infiltrating up the veins of command with mere token resistance.

Winter's Essence.lore: These pure, snow-white leggings are rumored to have been crafted by the legendary ice mage Theorick. The people of Nesaak view them as cursed, seeking to destroy them in a bid to stop the endless winter surrounding them.

Witherhead's Elbow.lore: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.

Witherhead's Talisman.lore: "My dear boy should never have to go through the horrors of losing a mother like that." -Momo, adoptive mother of Bob

Withstand.lore: Despite the valley being overtaken by anomalous forces, the toughest flora has managed to avoid extinction. Their coiling vines and roots remind you that even in the most dire of situations, you will never go quietly.

Woebegone.lore: For some, the psychological impact of the undead incursions becomes too much to bear. They leave their lives behind hoping to find solace, only to return as an undead themselves.

majorIds.Self-sufficient: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Self-sufficient.text: Powder Specials can no longer be charged manually, but accumulate 8% charge every second.

Wybel Paw.lore: Even reduced to just the bones, you can't help but feel bad for the poor thing this paw came from.

Wynnter Fair 2016 Souvenir.lore: Thank you for participating in the 2016 Wynnter Fair!

Wynnter Fair 2017 Souvenir.lore: Thank you for participating in the 2017 Wynnter Fair!

Wynnterfest 2016 Souvenir.lore: Thank you for participating in Wynnterfest 2016!

Wysteria Glooms.lore: Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.

X-PM1 Adjudicator.lore: Complex lenses such as the ones in this plating are specially designed to grant secondary visual guidance, offering rapid peripheral and otherwise situational awareness alongside the wider visual scope. A standard in certainty, always at least providing worst-case countermeasures in the densest fog of war.

X-PM2 Insurgency.lore: The ultimate folly of a heavyweight war machine. Too big to dodge and too easy to hit, with this core being the conclusion of this conflict. Still undeniably bulky, but just lightweight enough to allow rapid movement through short energy bursts. A luxury to most mechs of this scale.

X-PM3 Exclusion Zone.lore: Some mechs, particularly those built with long range in mind, are equipped with gyroscopic subcores like these to give more consistent aim and spatial control in active warfare. Fragile machinery compared to other systems, but a worthwhile trade compared to being staggered or raining fire on allies from being glanced by artillery.

X-PM4 Deadlock.lore: Reinforced leg plating for heavyweight machines. Built to last- and then some. Namely to hold such massive things up readily, but also to keep as pressing of a threat as long as possible- threatening destruction only under critical core damage, rather than being knocked down by a well placed hit.

Xenolith.lore: Hidden amongst the foundations of the Expanse are anomalous fragments wrapped in an otherworldly power. While unsettling to the touch, the strength they impart is too tempting to ignore.

Xenotransplantation.lore: Your flesh is but a weak imitation of power, a flabby welter of gushing blood and brittle bones, stitched together with threads of weak hope. There is only one way through: you must supplant your failing heart.

Xiuhtecuhtli.lore: This turquoise mask burns into your skin, binding flesh and stone. The flames are a constant reminder of the balance between creation and destruction, and that the fire which sustains can also consume.

Yellow Wynnter Sweater.lore: The sweater has the quote "YELLOW- How's your Craftmas going" knitted onto the front.

majorIds.Soul Eater: Devour and Harvester grant double mana. Decreases maximum marks by 1.

Soul Eater.text: Devour and Harvester grant double mana. Decreases maximum marks by 1.

Zephra Shredder.lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.

Zero.lore: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.
